ಶ್ರೌತದ ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೀಗೆ ಸೃಚಿಯನ್ನು ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾರಾದರೂ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಗೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ಮಹಾಸೃಚಿ ಮಾಡಿಸುವುದಕ್ಕೇ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಬಂದಲ್ಲಿ ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಮಹಾಸೃಚಿ ಮಾಡಿಸುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟವೇ ಸರಿ. ವ್ಯಾವಹಾರಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಹಾಕುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನಿಯಮ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ವಿಧಿ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಹಾಕಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಉಪಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಸೃಚಿಯನ್ನು ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸಿ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಹೋಮ ಮಾಡಲು ಬರುವುದೇ? ಕುಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದಿರುವ ತುಪ್ಪದಿಂದ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮೌದನವನ್ನೂ ಬೇಯಿಸಲು ಬರುವುದೇ? ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವ ಗೃಹ್ಯಸೂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ವಿಧಿ ಇರಲಿಕ್ಕಿಲ್ಲ. ಯಜ್ಞದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಜ್ಞಾಯುಧವನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸಲು ಅಗ್ನಿಮುಖ ಸೂತ್ರವಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಮರ್ಪಣೆ ಮಾಡದಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಉಪಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದು ಹೇಳುವಂತೆಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಜ್ಞಾಯುಧಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸಲು ವಿಧಿ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸಬಹುದಾಗಿದೆ.

೫.ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ಪರಮಮೂಲ ಇರುವುದು ಶುಕ್ಲಯಜುರ್ವೇದದ ಶತಪಥ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣದಲ್ಲಿ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಯಣ ಭಾಷ್ಯವಿದೆ. ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಕುರಿತು ವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾದ ಭಾಷ್ಯವಿದೆ.
ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನದ ಅಂಗವಾಗಿ ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯಹೋಮ ಮತ್ತು ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮವಿದೆ. ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಅಗ್ನಿದೇವತೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾಗಿಯೇ ಇದೆ. ಅದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ರುದ್ರನೇ ಅಗ್ನಿಸ್ವರೂಪ ಎಂಬ ತತ್ತ್ವವಿದೆ. ಇದು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ರುದ್ರನ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅನುಷ್ಠಾನವಲ್ಲ. ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ರೈಷ ಸರ್ವೋಗ್ನಿಃ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಃ ಎಂದಿದೆ. ವಿಹಿತೋಯಂ ಹೋಮೋ ರುದ್ರರೂಪತಾಪನ್ನಸ್ಯಾಗ್ನೇರುಪಶಮನಾರ್ಥ ಇತ್ಯಾಹ - ರುದ್ರರೂಪತಾಪದ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಉಪಶಮನಾರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯ ಹೋಮ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಮುಂದೆ ಪ್ರವರ್ಗ್ಯ, ಉಪಸತ್,ಮಂಡೂಕವಿಕರ್ಷಣ ಮುಂತಾದ ಹಲವಾರು ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿದ್ದು ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಅಗ್ನಿಯ ಆರಾಧನೆಯೇ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಅತ್ರೈಷ ಸರ್ವೋಗ್ನಿಃ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಃ. ಸ ಏಷೋತ್ರ ವಸುಃ. ತಸ್ಮೈ ದೇವಾ ಏತಾಂ ಧಾರಾಂ ಪ್ರಾಗೃಹ್ಣನ್.ತಯೈನಮಪ್ರೀಣನ್. ತದ್ ಯದೇತಸ್ಮೈ ವಸವ ಏತಾಂ ಧಾರಾಂ ಪ್ರಗೃಹ್ಣನ್ ತಸ್ಮಾದೇನಾಂ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೇತ್ಯಾಚಕ್ಷತೇ. ತಥೈವಾಸ್ಮಾ ಅಯಮೇತಾಂ ಧಾರಾಂ ಪ್ರಗೃಹ್ಣಾತಿ. ತಯೈನಂ ಪ್ರೀಣಾತಿ.    ಅಗ್ನಿಯು ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ. ಅಗ್ನಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಸುಸ್ವರೂಪ. ಈ ವಸುಧಾರೆಯ ಧಾರೆಯಿಂದ ದೇವತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ತೃಪ್ತಿಯಾಗುವುದು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವಸು ಎಂದರೆ ಧನವೂ ಹೌದು. ಅಗ್ನಿಯೂ ಹೌದು. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯು ಕೂಡಾ ಯಜ್ಞಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವುದಾದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಅಗ್ನಿದೇವತೆಗೇ ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸುವ ಆಹುತಿಯಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಅಗ್ನಿಪ್ರೀತ್ಯರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತ್ಯನಂತರ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ ವಿಹಿತ. ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯಿಂದಲೂ ಸಕಲದೇವತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಎಂದಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯೂ ಸಹ ದೇವತೆಗಳಿಗೂ ತೃಪ್ತಿಕರವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಸೂಕ್ತವಾದುದು.
ಅಥ ಪುನಸ್ತಾಮೇವ
ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾಂ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಾಗ್ನೇರಭಿಷೇಕಾತ್ಮನಾ ಪ್ರಶಂಸತಿ
ಇಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯೂ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಾಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಅಭಿಷೇಕವೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ.
೬.ವಾಜಶ್ಚ ಮೇ ಪ್ರಸವಶ್ಚ ಮೇ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಮಂತ್ರೋಕ್ತಾ ವಾಜಾದಯಃ ಕಾಮ್ಯಮಾನತ್ವಾತ್ ಕಾಮಶಬ್ದೇನೋಚ್ಯತೇ. ತೈಶ್ಚ ಏತಯಾ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಯಾ ಚ ಅಭಿಷಿಂಚೇತ್. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಜಶ್ಚ ಮೇ ಪ್ರಸವಶ್ಚ ಮೇ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾಮ್ಯಮಾನತ್ವವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಚಮಕದ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಗೂ ಈ ಫಲಗಳಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಮಾಂತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂದರೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರ ಅಧಿಕಫಲಕಾಮನೆಗಾಗಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯಿಂದ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಅಭಿಷೇಕ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ ಯುಕ್ತವಾದುದು. ಮಾಡಲೇಬೇಕೆಂಬ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ನಿಯಮವೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
೭.ವೇದದಲ್ಲಿ ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯ ಹೋಮದಿಂದ ಶಿವನ ಘೋರತನುಶಮನ, ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯಿಂದ ಶಿವತನುಪ್ರೀಣನ ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಇದು ಯಜ್ಞಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಕಲ್ಪ. ಈ ಕಲ್ಪದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ರುದ್ರಾನುಷ್ಠಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಭಟ್ಟಭಾಸ್ಕರ ಭಾಷ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ವಿಧಿ ಇದೆ. ಇದನ್ನೇ ಮೂಲಪ್ರಕೃತಿ ಎಂದು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡುವುದಾದರೆ ಆಗ ೩/೬/೧೬ ಆವರ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪಕ್ಷ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ ಅರ್ಕಪರ್ಣದ ಮುಖಾಂತರ ಕ್ಷೀರಧಾರೆ - ಒಂದೇ ಆವರ್ತಿ - ತಿಷ್ಠದ್ಧೋಮ(ನಾಭಿದಧ್ನ, ಜಾನುದಧ್ನ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ನಿಯಮಗಳಿವೆ)ಹೀಗೆ ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯ ಹೋಮ ಪೂರ್ತಿಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಅನಂತರ ಚಮಕಾನುವಾಕಗಳಿಂದ ಮಹಾಸೃಚಿಯಿಂದ ಆಜ್ಯಧಾರಾಪೂರ್ವಕ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮ - ತಿಷ್ಠದ್ಧೋಮ ಹೀಗೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದು ಸಮಗ್ರ ನಮಕಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಸಮಗ್ರ ಚಮಕ. ಇದು ಅಯಜ್ಞಸಂಯುಕ್ತಕಲ್ಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿದೇಶವಾಗಿ ಬರಲಿಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಧಾಯಕ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಿಲ್ಲ. ೧೧/೧೨೧/೧೩೩೧/೧೪೬೪೧ ಆವರ್ತಿಯ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮಕ್ಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಶತಾಂಶ, ದಶಾಂಶ ಹೋಮಕ್ಕೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಲಾಗದು. ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತದ ಮಹಾರುದ್ರದವರೆಗಿನ ಹೋಮಗಳು ಶ್ರೌತದ ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯದ ರೂಪಾಂತರ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಚಮಕಹೋಮವೂ ಸಹಿತ ವೇದದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ರೂಪಾಂತರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯವು ರೂಪಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮವಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಚಮಕವೂ ಇದೆ.ಆದರೆ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯು ರೂಪಾಂತರವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಬರಬೇಕು ಎನ್ನುವ ವಾದವೇ ವಿಚಿತ್ರವಾದುದು. ರೂಢಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಬರಲಾಗಿದೆ ಸಮರ್ಥನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಉಪಾಯ ಅಷ್ಟೇ.
 
 ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಕುರಿತು ವಿದ್ವಾನ್ ಗಣಪತಿ ಭಟ್ಟರು ಕಿಬ್ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಇವರು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು, ವಿದ್ವಾನ್ ರಾಮಕೃಷ್ಣ ಭಟ್ಟರು, ಯಲ್ಲಾಪುರ, ವಿದ್ವಾನ್ ಬಾಲಚಂದ್ರ ಭಟ್ಟರು, ಭಟ್ರಕೇರಿ, ವಿದ್ವಾನ್ ಪರಮೇಶ್ವರ ಭಟ್ಟರು ಪುಟ್ಟನಮನೆ ಇವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ ಲೇಖನಗಳ ಸಾರಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಇವರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಎಂದು ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ.( ಕೆಲವು ಶ್ರೌತವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರು ಬೋಧಾಯನ ಶ್ರೌತಸೂತ್ರ/ ಆಪಸ್ತಂಬ ಶ್ರೌತಸೂತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನದ ಕುರಿತು ಹಲವು ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದ್ದು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಾದರೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಆನಂತರವೇ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಸೂಕ್ತವೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಸಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕಾರಣಾಂತರಗಳಿಂದ ತಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಲೇಖನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿಸಬಾರದಾಗಿ ಅಪೇಕ್ಷಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ)

 1.ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರನಮಕಾನುವಾಕ ಆಹುತಿ ಮೂರು ಮಂತ್ರ ವಿಭಾಗ,  ಆರು ಮಂತ್ರ ವಿಭಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ೧೬ ಮಂತ್ರವಿಭಾಗದಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ೪೮/೧೬೯ ಮಂತ್ರವಿಭಾಗವು ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಮಹಾರುದ್ರ, ಅತಿರುದ್ರಗಳೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಅವು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು. ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮಾನಂತರ ಚಮಕಾನುವಾಕಗಳಿಂದ ಆಹುತಿ ಎಂದು ಇಲ್ಲ ಹಲವು ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಅನಂತರ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ  ಇದೆ. ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವಿಧಿ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಹೀಗೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಸರಿ. ಆದರೆ ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತಕರ್ಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇದನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಲಿಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಧಿವಾಕ್ಯ ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.  ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗೆ ಪವಿತ್ರಕರಣಂ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಷಣೀಸಂಸ್ಕಾರ ಪ್ರಣೀತಾಪ್ರಣಯನಂ ಸ್ರುಕ್ಸ್ರುವಸಂಮ್ಮಾರ್ಜನಮಿತಿ ದರ್ಶಪೂರ್ಣಮಾಸವತ್ತೂಷ್ಣೀಮ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೌತದ ವಿಧಿಯನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲು ಸೂಚಿಸಿದ ಹಾಗೆ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನೂ ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಿರುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಂಬ ವಿಧಿವಾಕ್ಯ ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.  ಶ್ರೌತದ ಯಾಗ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಬೇರೆ ಗೃಹ್ಯದ ಹೋಮನಿಯಮಗಳು ಬೇರೆ. ಒಂದೇ ಕರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವೆಡೆ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಭಿನ್ನತೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಮಾಡಿರಿ ಎಂಬ ವಿಧಿವಾಕ್ಯಗಳು ಕಂಡುಬರದೆ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಮೊದಲು ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅದು ವಿಧಿಹೀನ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಧಿವಾಕ್ಯ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದರೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮವಿಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ  ಜೊತೆಗೆ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ವಿಧಿಸಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಹಾಗೆ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ ಸರಿ. ಅದೇ ವಿಧಿವತ್ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಮಾಡಲೇಬೇಕೆಂದು ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ನಿಯಮವಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಗ್ನಿಂ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತಂಚಾಂತರೇಣೋಪಹೋಮಾಃ ಎನ್ನುವುದು ಉಪಹೋಮದ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಹೊರತು ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ತರಲು ಹೇತು ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಉಪಹೋಮತ್ವ ಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಆಗಬೇಕಾದರೆ ವಿಧಾಯಕ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಿರಬೇಕು. 

2.ಸ್ವಾಹೇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಸಂತತಧಾರಯೇತಿ ಮೀಮಾಂಸಕಾಃ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಕುರಿತ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ವ ಮೀಮಾಂಸೆಯ ೧೨ನೇ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದ ೩ನೇ ಪಾದ ೧೧ನೇ ಅಧಿಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು.
೧೦ನೇ ಅಧಿಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂತ್ರಾಂತೇನ ಕರ್ಮಾದಿ ಸನ್ನಿಪಾತಸ್ಸ್ಯಾತ್ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸುವಾಗ ಮಂತ್ರದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಶಬ್ದ ಹೇಳಿ ಮುಗಿಯದೇ ಆ ಮಂತ್ರ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗಲಾರದಷ್ಟೇ? ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಮಂತ್ರಾದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಂತ್ರಮಧ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮವನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳದೇ ಮಂತ್ರದ ಅಂತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮವನ್ನು ಆಚರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಿ ೧೨ನೇ ಅಧಿಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ವೈಷಮ್ಯವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಸಂತತಾಂ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾಂ ಜುಹೋತಿ ಅಥವಾ ದ್ವಾದಶದ್ವಾದಶಾನಿ ಜುಹೋತಿ ಎಂಬಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಿಚ್ಛಿನ್ನಧಾರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಂತತ್ಯ ವಿಹಿತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಮಂತ್ರಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ಮಗಳ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಎಂದು ಪೂರ್ವಪಕ್ಷ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವಿಚಿತ್ರವೆಂಬಂತೆ ಸಂತತವಚನಾದ್ಧಾರಾಯಾಮಾದಿ ಸಂಯೋಗಃ ಎಂಬದು ಪೂರ್ವ ಪಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ ಸೂತ್ರಿತವಾಗಿದೆ.
ಕರ್ಮಸಂತಾನೋ ವಾ ನಾನಾಕರ್ಮತ್ವಾದಿತರಸ್ಯಾಶಕ್ಯತ್ವಾತ್ ಎಂಬುದು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಹನ್ನೆರಡೂ ಹೋಮಗಳ ಸಾಂತತ್ಯ ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದು, ಮಂತ್ರಕರ್ಮಗಳ ಸಾಂತತ್ಯವಲ್ಲ! ಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಕರ್ಮವು ಮಂತ್ರದ ಜೊತೆ ಸಾಗಲಾರದು! ಮಂತ್ರಕರ್ಮಸಾಂತತ್ಯಸ್ಯ - ಅಶಕ್ಯತ್ವಾತ್ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಆಘಾರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮಂತ್ರಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಗ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆಯಲ್ಲ!? ಎಂಬುದು ಮುಂದಿನ ಅಧಿಕರಣದ ವಿಶಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆಘಾರೇ ಚ ದೀರ್ಘ ಧಾರಾತ್ವಾತ್ ಆಘಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮ ಮಾತ್ರ ಗ್ರಾಹ್ಯ ವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಕರ್ಮಸಾಂತತ್ಯ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ! ಎಂದು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ... ಮಂತ್ರಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಜ್ಯಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಹಲವು ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಈ ಸಂತತಾಂ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ! ಎಂದು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇರಲಿ ಪ್ರಕೃತ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು (ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತ್ಯಂತೇ) ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಮ ಮಾಡುವುದು  ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿರುವಾಗ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃದಂತರೇಣ ಎಂಬ ಉದ್ಗಾರ ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ..... ನನ್ನ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರ ಚಮಕ ಹೋಮವನ್ನು(ರುದ್ರ ಹೋಮಾಂಗವಾದ) ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ತಿನ ಒಳಗೂ, ಚಮಕ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಸಂತತಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತ್ಯಂತದಲ್ಲೂ ಆಚರಿಸುವುದು ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

 3.ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರ ಹೋಮದ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿಯ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಎಂಟು ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಎಂದು ಆಶ್ರಯಿಸಿ, ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವಾದ ಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸುಧಾರೆಯ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೇ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿರುವ ವಿಧಿಯು ಅಪ್ರಮಾಣವೆನ್ನುವುದು ಅರ್ಧಜರತೀಯವಾಗುತ್ತದಲ್ಲವೇ? ಕೇವಲ ಅರ್ಧಜರತೀಯವಲ್ಲ, ಆಶ್ರಯವ್ಯಾಘಾತ ದೋಷವಿಲ್ಲವೇ?

4.ಯಾವಾಗ ಈ ನಿಬಂಧ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲೇ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ವಸುಧಾರೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿ ವಿಧಿಯಿದೆಯೋ ಅಂಗಾಂಗಿಭಾವ ಶಮನವಾಗಿದೆಯೋ ಆಗ ಅತಿದೇಶದ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಏನಿದೆ?
ಸೂತ್ರವನ್ನೇ ಪರಮ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವೆಂದು, ಸೂತ್ರವಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮೂಲವೆನ್ನುವವರು ಇಲ್ಲೂ ಸಹ ಸೂತ್ರವಿನ್ನುಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡೇ ವಿಚಾರ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ಅನೇಕ ಕಡೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೋಧಾಯನಾದಿ ಆಚಾರ್ಯರೇ ‘ದರ್ಶಪೂರ್ಣಮಾಸವತ್ ತೂಷ್ಣೀಂ’ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಅತಿದೇಶವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರ ಹೋಮದ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ರೀತಿಯ ಅತಿದೇಶವಿಧಾಯಕ ಸೂತ್ರವಿದೆಯೇ? ಇಲ್ಲವಾದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವೇ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಮಾಡುವ ಅತಿದೇಶ ಉತ್ಸೂತ್ರವೆಂದೋ ಅಥವಾ ವೈಧವಲ್ಲವೊಂದೋ, ನಿರ್ಮೂಲವೆಂದೋ ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

5.ಸೂತ್ರಕಾರರೇನಾದರೂ ಈ ಅತಿದೇಶವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆಯೇ? ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟೂ ಸಹ, ನಾವು ಶ್ರೌತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ವಿಚಾರವನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಆದರೆ ‘ತಸ್ಯೈತೇ ಘೋರತನು..’, ‘ಯತ್ಕಾಮ ಏನಾಂ ಜುಹೋತಿ’ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳು ಶ್ರೌತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ಭಾವನಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಡಿ ಚರಿತಾರ್ಥ ಆದವು. ಹಾಗಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅವು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರ ಹೋಮದ ಸಾಧ್ಯಸಾಧನಾದಿ ಆಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಪೂರೈಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವಾಕ್ಯ ಆಗುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಪ್ರಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರಿತಾರ್ಥವಾದ ಶ್ರೌತರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಕರಣದಿಂದ ಹೊರಗೆ ಅಪೋದ್ಧಾರ ಮಾಡಿ, ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ಸಾಧ್ಯಸಾಧನಾದಿ ಆಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಪೂರೈಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಲು ಪ್ರಮಾಣವೇನು ಎನ್ನುವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

6.ಅಥಾತೋ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾಂ ಜುಹೋತಿ. ತಸ್ಯೈ ದೇವಾ ಏತಾಂ ಧಾರಾಂ ಪ್ರಾಗೃಹ್ಣನ್ ತೇನೈನಮಪ್ರೀಣನ್... ತಸ್ಮಾದೇನಾಂ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆತ್ಯಾಚಕ್ಷತೇ...ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ...ಮಂತ್ರಾರ್ಥ: ವೈಶ್ವಾನರ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರುತ ಹೋಮಗಳ ನಂತರ 'ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ' ಹೋಮ ದಿಂದ ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಈ ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಿ ಅದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಅಗ್ನಿಯನ್ನು ತೃಪ್ತಿಪಡಿಸಿದರು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದಲೇ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ 'ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ' ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರು ಬಂದಿದೆ. ಇದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಯಜಮಾನನು ತನ್ನ ಆಯುಷ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ವೃದ್ಧಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.ಯದೇವೈತಾಂ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾಂ ಜುಹೋತಿ.ಅಭಿಷೇಕ ಏವಾಸ್ಯೈಷಃ. ಏತದ್ವಾ ಏನಂ ದೇವಾಃ ಸರ್ವಂ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಂ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ್ಯ ಅಥೈನಮೇತೈಃ ಕಾಮೈರಭ್ಯಷಿಂಚನ್...
ಮಂತ್ರಾರ್ಥ: ಈ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮವು ಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ ಅಗ್ನಿಯ ಪಟ್ಟಾಭಿಷೇಕದ ಸಂದರ್ಭವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನ ವೇದಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ ಮುಗಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ, ಆ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಕಲ ಕಾಮನೆಗಳ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಗಾಗಿ ಈ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ 'ಅಭಿಷೇಕ' ಮಾಡಿದರು.
ಹೀಗೆ  ಮುಂದುವರೆದು ಇದಂ ಚ ಮೇ ಇದಂ ಚ ಮೇ ಇತಿ... ಸಾ ಯದೈವೈಷಾ ಧಾರಾಗ್ನಿಂ ಪ್ರಾಪೃಣುಯಾದ್ ಅಥೈತದ್ಯಜುಃ ಪ್ರತಿಪದ್ಯೇತ ಎಂಬ ಮಂತ್ರ ದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಮಕ  ಪ್ರಶ್ನ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ವಿನಿಯೋಗ ಹೇಳಿದೆ.

7.ಅಗ್ನಿಂ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತಂ ಚಾಂತರೇಣ"  ಸೂತ್ರದ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೃಹ್ಯಸೂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಾಗಲಿ ಅಥವಾ 'ಅನಾಕುಲಾ ವೃತ್ತಿ’ ಅಥವಾ "ತಾತ್ಪರ್ಯದರ್ಶನ" ದಲ್ಲಾಗಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲೂ ಶಬ್ದಶಃ ಬರೆದಿಲ್ಲ.

8.ಶತಪಥ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು "ಸರ್ವಂ ವೈ ಪೂರ್ಣಮ್" ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.
ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯು ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಹೋಮವೇ ಅಥವಾ ಉಪಹೋಮವೇ? ಮೀಮಾಂಸೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಹೋಮಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಫಲವಿರಬೇಕು. ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಪ್ರಧಾನವೆನ್ನಲು ಗೃಹ್ಯಸೂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಾಗಲಿ, ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಾಗಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾದರೂ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವಿಧಿ ಇದೆಯೇ? ಇಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ವೇಳೆ ಅದು ಉಪಹೋಮವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಜಯಾದಿಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಮುನ್ನವೇ ಮುಗಿಯಬೇಕಿತ್ತು, ಆದರೆ ಜಯಾದಿಗಳ ನಂತರವೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕ ಪದ್ಧತಿ.

9.ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಹೋಮಗಳ ನಂತರ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಜಯಾದಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೆರವೇರಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ 'ಯದಸ್ಯ ಕರ್ಮಣೋ...' ಎಂಬ ಮಂತ್ರದಿಂದ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್/ಪ್ರಾಯಶ್ಚಿತ್ತ ಸ್ರುವಾಹುತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ನ್ಯೂನತಾ ಪ್ರಾಯಶ್ಚಿತ್ತಗಳು ಮುಗಿದು, ಪರಿಸ್ತರಣಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಸರ್ಜಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆಯೇ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಆಪಸ್ತಂಬರ "ಅಗ್ನಿಂ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತಂ ಚಾಂತರೇಣ" ಎಂಬ ಸೂತ್ರವನ್ನು ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಿ ಕರ್ಮಭಂಗ ದೋಷಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲವೇ ,

10.ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಒಳಗೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ತುರುಕುವುದು ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಕ್ಕೂ ಹೊಂದಿಕೆಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಜಯಾದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಯಶ್ಚಿತ್ತಗಳು ಮುಗಿದು, ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವುದು ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಸಕಲ ಶ್ರೌತ-ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತ ಕ್ರಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಬದ್ಧವಾದ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಮಾರ್ಗವಾಗಿದೆ."
ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಆಪಸ್ತಂಬರ 'ಅಗ್ನಿಂ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತಂ ಚಾಂತರೇಣ' ಸೂತ್ರದ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಂದು ಮೊದಲನೇ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್‌ಗಿಂತ ಮುಂಚೆಯೇ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ, ಆ ನಂತರ ಬರುವ ಜಯಾದಿ ಹೋಮಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ? ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಯಜ್ಞದ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಉಪಹೋಮ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಎಂದು ಯಾವ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ?"

11.ವಿಕೃತಿ ಕರ್ಮ ( ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತ ಹೋಮ) ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಮಾಡಲೇ ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ವಿಧಿಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ ಗಳು ಇದೆಯೇ? ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮೊದಲು "ವಿಧಾಯಕ ಸೂತ್ರ" (ಅದನ್ನು ಮಾಡಲೇಬೇಕು ಎಂಬ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ನಿಯಮ) ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ. ಮೂಲ ನಿಯಮವೇ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವಾಗ, ಅದರ ಸ್ಥಾನದ ಕುರಿತು ಚರ್ಚಿಸುವುದು ನಿರರ್ಥಕ.

12.ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ಚಮಕ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ "ಉಪಹೋಮ" ಅಥವಾ "ಕರ್ಮವ್ಯಂಜಕ" ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಚಮಕ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳ ವಿನಿಯೋಗ ಉಪಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಹೇಗೆ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ಚಮಕ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ "ಕರ್ಮವ್ಯಂಜಕ" ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯ.   ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾದ ನಮಕವೇ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತವಾಗಿ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವಾಗ, ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡುವ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯು ನಮಕವನ್ನು 'ಅಭಿವ್ಯಂಜಿಸುವ' ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. ಚಮಕ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾಡುವ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ನಾವು ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಕರ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ 'ಉಪಹೋಮ' ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯ? ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಹೋಮವೇ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲವಲ್ಲ. ಚಮಕ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳ ಎರಡು ರೂಪದ ಎರಡು ಉಪ ಹೋಮಗಳ ಇವು?

13.  ರುದ್ರಹೋಮವು ಮೂಲ ಪಾಕಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲ ಅಲ್ಲವೇ!ಬೋಧಾಯನರು ವಿಧಿಸಿದ ಮೂಲ ೭ ಪಾಕಯಜ್ಞ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಔಪಾಸನ, ವೈಶ್ವದೇವ, ಸ್ಥಾಲೀಪಾಕ, ಅಷ್ಟಕಾ,..... ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಮಕ-ಚಮಕಗಳ ಈ 'ರುದ್ರಹೋಮ' ಬರುವುದೇ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಲ್ಲವೇ.  ಪಾಕಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಉಪಹೋಮದ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಹಚ್ಚುವುದಕ್ಕಿಂತ — ಶ್ರೌತದ ಹವಿಃಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಾದ 'ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನ'ದಿಂದ ಬಂದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ಮೂಲ ಇರುವುದು ಶ್ರೌತದ 'ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನ' ಯಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ. ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕಲ ದೇವತೆಗಳ ಆಹುತಿಗಳು, ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್, ಪ್ರಾಯಶ್ಚಿತ್ತ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಮುಗಿದು ಯಾಗವು ಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗುವ ಸಮಾಪ್ತಿಯ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಅಖಂಡವಾಗಿ ಎರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶ್ರೌತದ ಆಧಾರವನ್ನು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮಕ್ಕೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವಾಗ (ಅತಿದೇಶ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ), ಅದರ ಮೂಲ ಸ್ಥಾನವಾದ "ಇಡೀ ಹೋಮದ ಅಂತ"ವನ್ನೇ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಬೇಕೇ ಹೊರತು, ಮಧ್ಯದ ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಜಾಗವನ್ನಲ್ಲ.  

14.ಪಾದಾದಿಕೇಶಾಂತ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳುವಲ್ಲಿ  ಕೇಶಾಂತ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇಶದ ಬುಡವೋ ಅಥವಾ ಕೇಶದ ತುದಿ ಅಂತಲೋ?? ಹಾಗಾಗಿ "ಅಂತೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಚ" ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಹೊರತು, "ಪ್ರಧಾನಾಂತೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ" ಎಂದಾಗಲಿ ಅಥವಾ "ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃದಂಗತ್ವೇನ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ" ಎಂದಾಗಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಬರೆದಿಲ್ಲ. ಕಾರಣ , , ಬಂದಿರುವ 'ಅಂತ' ಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ 'ಇಡೀ ಹೋಮದ ಅಂತ' (ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ) ಎಂದು ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ.

15.ತ್ರೇಧಾವಿಭಾಗಪಕ್ಷದ ಏಕಾದಶರುದ್ರಹೋಮ(ಸಮಗ್ರಹೋಮ) ದಲ್ಲಿ -
ತ್ರೇಧಾವಿಭಾಗಪಕ್ಷಾಶ್ರಯಣೇನ ತಿಸ್ರ ಆಹುತಯಃ. ತತಶ್ಚಮಕಾನುವಾಕೈರ್ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಚ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣಹೋಮಪಕ್ಷೇ ಪ್ರತಿರೂಪಕಂ ತಿಸ್ರ ತಿಸ್ರ ಆಹುತಯ ಇತಿ ತ್ರಯಸ್ತ್ರಿಂಶತ್. ರೂಪಕಾಂತೇ ರೂಪಕಾಂತೇ ಏಕೈಕೇನ ಚಮಕವಿಭಾಗೇನೈಕೈಕಾ ಆಹುತಿರೇಕಾದಶಪೂರ್ವಾಭಿಃ ಸಹ ಚತುಶ್ಚತ್ವಾರಿಂಶತ್. ಅಂತೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಚ " ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯವಿದೆ.ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು  ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್‌ನ ಒಳಗಿನ ಕೇವಲ ಒಂದು  ಅಂಗ ಎಂದು ವಾದಿಸಿದರೆ, ಇಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಡಿರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಆಹುತಿಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರವು ತಪ್ಪಾಗುತ್ತದೆ . ಅನ್ವಾಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೆಲವರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಹೋಮ ಅಥವಾ ಉಪ ಹೋಮ  ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಅನ್ವಾಧಾನ ಮಾಡಲು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ? ಅನ್ವಾಧಾನದ ನಿಯಮದಂತೆ, ಯಾವ ದೇವತೆಗೆ ಯಾವ ದ್ರವ್ಯದಿಂದ ಹೋಮ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆಯೋ ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸಬೇಕು ಉದಾ: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ದೇವತಾ, ಅಂಗ ದೇವತಾ. ಚಮಕದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯು ಕೇವಲ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಉಪಹೋಮವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಪ್ರಧಾನದ ಜೊತೆಗೇ ಅದರ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ಗಣಿತ ಮುಗಿಯಬೇಕಿತ್ತು. ಆದರೆ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಗಣಿತವು  ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊರಗಿಟ್ಟಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ಅನ್ವಾಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇದನ್ನು 'ಉಪಹೋಮ' ಎಂದು ಸಂಕಲ್ಪ ಮಾಡಲು ಗಣಿತ ವಿರೋಧ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಉಪಹೋಮವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಹೋಮವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ.

16.ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಕೂಡ ಎಂಬ ಏಕವಚನ ಪದವು ಕೇವಲ  ಸ್ರುವ ಳದ ಆಹುತಿಯನ್ನು ಅಲ್ಲ. ಅದು ಚಮಕದ ೧೧ ಅನುವಾಕಗಳ ಪಠಣದ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೂ ಎಡೆಬಿಡದೆ ಸುರಿಯುವ ಒಂದು ಅಖಂಡ ಆಹುತಿ ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಅಲ್ಲವೇ.

17.೪೪ ಆಹುತಿಗಳ ವರೆಗೆ ಚಮಕದ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಬಿಡಿಯಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಿ ಆಹುತಿ ಕೊಡುವುದು 'ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯ ಅಂಗ ಹೋಮ'. ಅದಾದ ನಂತರ 'ಚ' ಶಬ್ದದಿಂದ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ, ಏಕವಚನದಿಂದ ಅಖಂಡ ಆಹುತಿ ಸಾರುವ ವಿಧಿಯೇ 'ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ'. ಇದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗೆ ಗಣನೆಗೆ ಬರದ ಅಖಂಡ ತತ್ತ್ವವಾದ್ದರಿಂದಲೇ ೪೪ ರ ಗಣಿತದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಇದನ್ನು ಹೊರಗಿಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.

18.ಉಪಹೋಮದ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಲಕ್ಷಣವೇ "ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಕರ್ಮವ್ಯಂಜಕತ್ವ".  ೪೪ ಶತರುದ್ರೀಯ ಆಹುತಿಗಳ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಮುಗಿದ ನಂತರವೇ "ಅಂತೇ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಚ" ಎಂದು ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ನಡೆಯುವ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾದ ನಮಕದ ಆಹುತಿಗಳು ಮುಗಿದುಹೋಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಕರ್ಮವೇ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತವಾಗಿ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವಾಗ, ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯು ಯಾರನ್ನು 'ಅಭಿವ್ಯಂಜಿಸಲು' ಸಾಧ್ಯ? ಪ್ರಧಾನವಿಲ್ಲದ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪಹೋಮತ್ವದ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ನಿಲ್ಲಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವೇ?

19.ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯ ಮೂಲ ಲಕ್ಷಣವೇ "ಅವಿಚ್ಛಿನ್ನಾಂ ಘೃತಧಾರಾಂ",  ಬಿಡಿಬಿಡಿಯಾಗಿ ಸುರಿಯುವ ವಿಧಿಗೆ ಇರುವ 'ಉಪಹೋಮ' ಎಂಬ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಅಲ್ಲವೇ.  "ಏಕಸ್ಯ ಉಭಯತ್ವೇ ಸಂಯೋಗಪೃಥಕ್ತ್ವಮ್" ನಿಯಮ" ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ, ಒಂದೇ ಮಂತ್ರಸಮುದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ (ಚಮಕಕ್ಕೆ) ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಎರಡು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ "ಉಪಹೋಮ" ಎಂಬ ಒಂದೇ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಹಚ್ಚಲು ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
ನಮಕದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಬಿಡಿಬಿಡಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಚಮಕದ ಆಹುತಿಗಳನ್ನು (೧೧ ಚಮಕಾಹುತಿಗಳು) "ಉಪಹೋಮ" ಎಂದು ಕರೆದ ಮೇಲೆ, ಅದರ ನಂತರ ಬರುವ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನೂ "ಉಪಹೋಮ" ಎನ್ನಲು ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಹಾಗೆ ಕರೆದರೆ ಅದು 'ಪುನರುಕ್ತಿ' ಮತ್ತು ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಸಂಕರ ದೋಷವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

20.ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಆ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಗಿಟ್ಟಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ಇದನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು 'ಉಪಹೋಮ' ಎಂದು ಸಂಕಲ್ಪ ಮಾಡಲು ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ಇಡೀ ಯಾಗದ ಫಲವನ್ನು ತಂದುಕೊಡುವ "ಯಾಗ ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿ" ರೂಪದ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ವಿಧಿಯೇ ಹೊರತು ಉಪಹೋಮವಲ್ಲ.

ಸಾರಾಂಶ
1.ಸ್ಮಾರ್ತರುದ್ರಹೋಮಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಭೂತವಾದ ಋಷಿವಾಕ್ಯ, ಸೂತ್ರವಾಕ್ಯ, ಸ್ಮೃತಿವಾಕ್ಯ, ಪುರಾಣವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯು ರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ಅಂಗವಾಗಿ ಉಕ್ತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸಹ ಹೇಳಿಲ್ಲ. ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡದಿದ್ದರೆ ಯಾವ ಲೋಪವೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ಅಂಗವಾಗಿ ಉಪಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸಲು ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಹಲವು ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಅನೇಕ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯವನ್ನೂ ಸಹ ಕೊಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.

2.  ಮದನಮಹಾರ್ಣವದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾಂಧಾತೃ ಕರ್ಮವಿಪಾಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತೇ ಅಂದರೆ ಚಮಕಾಂತ್ಯ ಎಂದು  ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ತಮಿಳುನಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕೇರಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವರು ಸ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕೃತ್ ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಬಂದು ಕ್ರಮೇಣ ರೂಢಿಗತವಾಯಿತೆಂದು  ಹೇಳಬಹುದು. ರೂಢಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಶಿವತನುಪ್ರೀಣನ, ಉಪಹೋಮ, ಅನ್ವಾಧಾನಸಂಕಲ್ಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದೆಲ್ಲಾ ಸಮರ್ಥನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸಲಾಯಿತು. ಆದರೆ ಮಹಾರ್ಣವದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಧಾನರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ಆಹುತಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿಲ್ಲ, ಹೊರಗೆ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ರುದ್ರಹೋಮವಿಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಚಮಕಾನುವಾಕಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಆಗ್ನೇಯಸೂಕ್ತ, ವಿಷ್ಣುಸೂಕ್ತ, ರುದ್ರಸೂಕ್ತ, ಐಂದವಸೂಕ್ತ, ವೈಶ್ವಾನರ ಸಾಮ, ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠಸಾಮಗಳನ್ನೂ ಸಹ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು ಉಪಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಮಕಗಳಿಂದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಸೂಕ್ತಗಳಿಂದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ಹೋಮ ಮಾಡಲು ಹೇಗೂ ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲವಷ್ಟೆ. ಅಲ್ಲದೆ ನವಗ್ರಹಶಾಂತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು ಫಲಭೂಯಸ್ತ್ವಕಾಮನೆಗಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವುದೆಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಕರ್ಮವಿಪಾಕ ಮಹಾರ್ಣವದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಂಧಾತೃ ಕರ್ಮವಿಪಾಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತೇ ಎಂದರೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತ್ಯಂತೇ ಎಂದೇ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು.ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಪಟ್ಟು ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆ ಹೇಳಿದೆ, ರುದ್ರಹೋಮಾಂಗವಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುವುದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ.

3.  ದಶಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಶತಾಂಶರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಶಿಷ್ಟರೂಪಕಕ್ಕೆ ದಶಾಂಶ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರಾ ವಿಧಿಯನ್ನು ನಿಬಂಧಕಾರರು ಮೀಮಾಂಸಾನ್ಯಾಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ವಿಧಿಸಿರುವುದು ಆಗಿದೆ. ಶ್ರೌತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ನಿಚಯನದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಅಗ್ನಿದೇವತೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿಯೇ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ, ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯೂ ಸಹ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಅಭಿಷೇಕವೇ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಚಮಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಗ್ನಿಯೂ ಒಂದು ದೇವತೆ ಆಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ಮತ್ಸ್ಯಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಿದ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯೂ ಸಹ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಪಟ್ಟೇ ಆಗ್ನೇಯಾದಿ ಸೂಕ್ತಗಳಿಂದ ಹೇಳಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ಪ್ರಧಾನದೇವತೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಇರಲಿ ಗೃಹ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಅಗ್ನಿದೇವತಾಪ್ರೀತಿಗಾಗಿಯೇ ಆಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ಮೀಮಾಂಸಾನ್ಯಾಯವೂ ಅನ್ವಯ ಆಗುವುದರಿಂದ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರವೇ ವಿಧಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ರುದ್ರಹೋಮದ ಅಂಗವಾಗಿ ಉಪಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಋಷಿವಾಕ್ಯ, ಸ್ಮೃತಿವಾಕ್ಯ, ಪುರಾಣವಾಕ್ಯ, ಸೂತ್ರವಾಕ್ಯ, ಸಾಯಣ ಭಾಷ್ಯ ವಿರುದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಸೇರಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರುದ್ರಹೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸೋರ್ಧಾರೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವುದಾದರೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಹುತಿಯ ಅನಂತರ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ ಸೂಕ್ತವಾದ, ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗವಾಗಿದೆ.

en.title: Vasordhārā in the Rudra homa: a reflection
en.body:
Subject: In the Rudra homa, should vasordhārā be performed after the pūrṇāhuti, or before the sviṣṭakṛt? Is vasordhārā an aṅga (subsidiary part) of the Rudra homa? This article contains a detailed reflection on these questions.
Vasordhārā is the rite in which two posts (stambhas) are set up, a large ladle (mahāsruc) is placed on them, and ghee is poured from a ghee-pot (ghṛtakumbha) into the mahāsruc while the Camaka anuvākas are recited, so that the offering flows into the fire as a continuous stream (santatadhārā) without the stream breaking in between. Its source lies in the Śrauta Sūtras such as Baudhāyana's. There is also a source in the Cayana Brāhmaṇa of the Taittirīya Saṃhitā of the Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda, and in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa of the Śukla Yajurveda. In the Matsya Purāṇa, in the navagraha śānti of one lakh oblations, vasordhārā is prescribed with the Āgneya and other sūktas.
Four views (pakṣas) are found regarding vasordhārā in the Rudra homa:
1. Performing only the Rudra homa, without the vasordhārā homa. (This is the most widely prevalent practice.)
2. Performing vasordhārā after the pūrṇāhuti.
3. Performing vasordhārā and then doing the pūrṇāhuti.
4. Performing vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt homa itself.
Smārta homas fall within the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa (rites not connected with the śrauta sacrifice). For the procedure (prayoga-vidhi) of the Rudra homa of this ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa, the nibandha texts and the prayoga texts are themselves the authority. Let us see where those texts state the place of vasordhārā in the Rudra homa.
1. In the Hiraṇyakeśīya Brahmakarma Samuccaya, in the procedure of the Rudra homa, it is given: pūrṇāhutiṃ vasordhārāṃ ca juhuyāt — that is, one should perform the pūrṇāhuti and, together with it, the vasordhārā.
2. In the Ṛgvedīya Brahmakarma Samuccaya too, in the procedure of the Rudra homa, it is given: pūrṇāhutiṃ vasordhārāṃ ca juhuyāt — that is, one should perform the pūrṇāhuti and, together with it, the vasordhārā. It is also stated there that the method of performing vasordhārā is to be looked up earlier, in the section on the graha-yajña taught in the Matsya Purāṇa.
3. In the text Anuṣṭhāna Prakāśa, other mantras are also given for vasordhārā, and the method of performing vasordhārā with the Camaka anuvākas after the pūrṇāhuti is stated thus: vājaśca me ityanuvākaiśca santatāṃ vasordhārāṃ juhuyāt. evaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ vasordhārāṃ ca hutvā ("With the anuvākas beginning vājaśca me one should offer the continuous vasordhārā. Having thus offered the pūrṇāhuti and the vasordhārā...").
4. In the text Śāntisāra too, in the procedure of the Rudra homa, the injunction is precisely pūrṇāhutiṃ vasordhārāṃ ca kṛtvā ("having performed the pūrṇāhuti and the vasordhārā").
5. In the Karmavipāka Mahārṇava it is enjoined: camakānām ekam ekam anuvākaṃ krameṇa hutvānte vasordhārāṃ juhuyāt ("Having offered the Camaka anuvākas one by one in order, at the end one should offer the vasordhārā"). Here it says ante vasordhārāṃ juhuyāt. In many places they say ante vasordhārāṃ ca, or tato vasordhārā. Because it says ante ("at the end"), some have understood it to mean that it should be done immediately after the upahoma oblations with the Camaka anuvākas are completed, and so among many the practice of performing vasordhārā before (within) the sviṣṭakṛt has become customary. But ante can also be understood to mean that, since the homa concludes with the pūrṇāhuti, the vasordhārā should be done then.
In the same Karmavipāka Mahārṇava, it is given, citing the text Cintāmaṇi, how the vasordhārā oblation is to be poured, and it is mentioned that the vasordhārā should be done with the Camaka anuvākas, and that there are other mantras as well.
In the same place, in the section on the navagraha-yajña, the vasordhārā is enjoined in the pūrṇāhuti after the oblation with the mantra mūrdhānaṃ....
In the same place it says: tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ ca hutvā phalabhūyastvakāmo vasordhārāṃ juhoti — after the sviṣṭakṛt, one who desires greater fruit should offer with the vasordhārā; and further on it explains: ghṛtakumbha vasordhārāṃ vihitāḥ camakānuvākā rudravidhāna prakaraṇadarśitaḥ — the procedure of vasordhārā from the ghee-pot with the Camaka anuvākas is stated in the section on Rudra. Nowhere here is it said that in the Rudra homa the vasordhārā is to be done immediately after the Camaka oblations of the upahoma, while in the navagraha yajña it is to be done after the pūrṇāhuti. Ante vasordhārā — when the text is examined as a whole, it becomes clear that the author of the Mahārṇava has used ante, tato and the like in the sense of "after the pūrṇāhuti".
6. In the text Śānti Kamalākara, in the procedure of the Rudra homa, the method of vasordhārā is given, and some sūktas such as the Āgneya sūkta are also mentioned:
āgneyasūktādi prāgukta baudhāyanokteḥ sarvacamakānte jñeyam | iyaṃ vasordhārā yadyapi mātsye lakṣahome evoktā tathāpi cayane dṛṣṭatvāt phalahetutvācca rudre kāryeti mahārṇavaḥ | sā ca pūrṇāhutyanantaraṃ kāryā
(The Āgneya sūkta and the others mentioned earlier, as taught by Baudhāyana, are to be understood as offered in the vasordhārā at the end of all the Camakas. Although this vasordhārā procedure is stated in the Mātsya, that is the Matsya Purāṇa, only in the navagraha yajña of one lakh oblations, nevertheless, because it is seen in the cayana (the agnicayana of the śrauta ritual) and because it bestows auspicious fruit, it should be performed in the Rudra homa as well — so it is enjoined in the Mahārṇava (the Karmavipāka Mahārṇava). And it is to be performed after the pūrṇāhuti.)
In the Śānti Kamalākara it is stated most clearly that the vasordhārā with the Camaka anuvākas must be performed only after the pūrṇāhuti. Since it also cites the Mahārṇava, it is confirmed that the ante vasordhārā repeatedly stated there means the end of the homa, that is, it must be done only after the pūrṇāhuti, and not before the sviṣṭakṛt. It also cites the cayana found in the śrauta ritual. Since it enjoins that in a Rudra homa performed according to the smārta/gṛhya procedure the vasordhārā must be done only after the pūrṇāhuti, and since it does not mention the view of vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt even as an option (vikalpa), it is established that performing vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt is not sanctioned.
7. Rudra Kalpadruma — this is a large work that sets out the procedure of Rudra anuṣṭhāna, and one of the authoritative texts on Rudra anuṣṭhāna. There too, in the section on each mantra, it is stated precisely as ante vasordhārā ca, tato vasordhārā....
In the same Rudra Kalpadruma, further on, in the procedure of the Rudra homa, the vasordhārā with the Camaka anuvākas is given only after the pūrṇāhuti. The ante vasordhārā ca, tato vasordhārā stated earlier — ante means at the end of the homa, that is, it is to be done only after the pūrṇāhuti. It is established that it is not done before the sviṣṭakṛt. It must be understood that the word tato has not been used in the sense of "it must be done immediately".
8. In the Vidhāna Pārijāta too, which is both an ancient text and an authoritative one, the vasordhārā is given only after the pūrṇāhuti. It is with the Āgneya and other sūktas.
9. In Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa's Rudrānuṣṭhāna Paddhati, in the pūrṇāhuti, the mantras mūrdhānaṃ..., sapta te agne.... and so on are given, and then tato vasordhārā ("then the vasordhārā"). There are details such as the udumbara ladle (udumbara-sruc), and the injunction is camakānuvākair vasordhārāṃ pātayet ("one should let the vasordhārā flow with the Camaka anuvākas"). Since the ten-fold repetition of kūyavāśca me is mentioned, it is understood that this is the procedure of vasordhārā with 144 oblations, in accordance with the Śruti statement dvādaśa dvādaśāni juhoti ("he offers twelve twelves"), stated in Sāyaṇa's commentary under a Mīmāṃsā maxim (nyāya). Afterwards other mantras are also given, and since it says evaṃ vasordhārāṃ vidhāya yathāśākhaṃ pūrṇapātravimocakādi karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayed ācāryaḥ ("Having thus performed the vasordhārā, the ācārya should complete the remainder of the rite, such as the release of the pūrṇapātra, according to his own śākhā"), it must be understood that this applies to those of all śākhās.
With this, it can be decided very clearly that in the Rudra homa of the smārta procedure the vasordhārā must take place together with the pūrṇāhuti.
10. In the Māndhātṛ Karmavipāka too, vasordhārā is mentioned in the Rudra homa. There too it is precisely ante, tato vasordhārā, and in the navagraha śānti the vasordhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti. Ante must be understood to mean the end of the homa.
That the vasordhārā performed with the Āgneya and other sūktas is likewise enjoined only after the pūrṇāhuti is found in the following texts.
11. In the Matsya Purāṇa, vasordhārā is mentioned in the navagraha homa of one lakh oblations. Here it is not stated with the Camaka. It is with the Āgneya and other sūktas.
12. In the text Saṃskāra Gaṇapati, which is a commentary on the Pāraskara Gṛhya Sūtra, in the navagraha śānti, vasordhārā with the Camakas is stated after the pūrṇāhuti.
13. In the prayoga of the saṃhitā homa according to the svāhākāra-vidhi of the Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda, the vasordhārā is given only after the pūrṇāhuti, and with the Camaka anuvākas themselves.
14. In the Śukla Yajurvedīya Karmakāṇḍa Pradīpa, in a certain śānti preceded by a graha-makha, vasordhārā with the Āgneya and other sūktas is stated after the pūrṇāhuti.
15. In the Śānti Mayūkha, in the navagraha śānti, vasordhārā with the Āgneya and other sūktas is stated after the pūrṇāhuti.
16. In the Śānti Prakāśa too, in the navagraha śānti, vasordhārā with the Āgneya and other sūktas is stated after the pūrṇāhuti.
17. In the Durgopāsana Kalpadruma, in the Caṇḍī homa, vasordhārā with the Āgneya and other sūktas is stated after the pūrṇāhuti.
18. In the Sāmavedīya Candrikā prayoga too, the vasordhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti.
19. In the Bṛhat Pārāśara Smṛti too, vasordhārā is stated in the navagraha homa of one lakh oblations.
20. In the texts cited above, such as the Karmavipāka Mahārṇava and the Śānti Kamalākara, too, in the navagraha śānti, vasordhārā with the Āgneya and other sūktas is stated after the pūrṇāhuti.
The argument of those who hold the view of performing vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt is as follows.
1. In the matter of Rudra, there is a relation of sequence (paurvāparya) between the Rudra-mantra oblations and the vasordhārā oblation. The injunctive (vidhi-codaka) Brāhmaṇa statements in the final brick (carameṣṭakā) of the śrauta agnikratu (agnicayana), yacchatarudrīyaṃ juhoti ("in that he offers the Śatarudrīya") and yad vasordhārāṃ juhoti ("in that he offers the vasordhārā"), are indicative of this. Since the vasordhārā oblation is also obligatory (nitya) for the Rudra, performing vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt (sviṣṭakṛtaḥ prāk) is more in accordance with the śāstra.
2. yaivāsya ghorā tanūs tāṃ tena śamayati. yad vasordhārāṃ juhoti yaivāsya śivā tanūs tāṃ tena prīṇāti — the vasordhārā exists so that Śiva's fierce form (ghora-tanu) may be pacified and so that he may be pleased. 3. Since it is said: rudrādhyāyastha mantrāṇāṃ mahāgnicayane caramāyām iṣṭakāyāṃ homasādhanatvena viniyogaḥ. camakādhyāyasya tu tatraiva vasordhārāhavanakarmaṇi viniyoga iti brāhmaṇān nirṇayaḥ ("The mantras of the Rudrādhyāya are employed as the means of the homa at the final brick in the mahāgnicayana; the Camakādhyāya is employed there itself in the rite of offering the vasordhārā — this is the determination from the Brāhmaṇa"), and since there both the homa with the Rudra anuvākas and the vasordhārā are present, they are of equal importance (sama-prādhānya). Likewise in the smārta Rudra homa, the vasordhārā must be performed immediately after the oblations with the Camaka anuvākas are completed, before the sviṣṭakṛt itself. Since it is so in the Saṃhitā, in the Brāhmaṇa and in the śrauta procedure, doing it that way is in accordance with the śāstra. Doing it together with the pūrṇāhuti is not appropriate.
4. Since the Baudhāyana Paribhāṣā Sūtra says agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāntareṇopahomāḥ ("the upahomas come between the [principal offering to] Agni and the sviṣṭakṛt"), the vasordhārā must fall within the upahoma.
5. Whatever is not stated in the gṛhya must be taken from the śrauta, as much as is needed.
6. Since the Mahārṇava Karmavipāka says ante, tato vasordhārā, the vasordhārā must be done at the very moment the Camaka oblations are completed.
7. Although there is a prohibition on offering homa while standing (tiṣṭhaddhoma), this is a special injunction (viśeṣa-vidhi).
8. Vasordhārā cannot be performed in the pūrṇāhuti after the samiṣṭayajus homa.
9. Since the paridhis (enclosing sticks) and paristaraṇa (strewn grass) are not present then, vasordhārā should not be performed together with the pūrṇāhuti.
10. Since there is a possibility of a lapse (vyatyaya) occurring in the continuous stream, if it is done before the sviṣṭakṛt there is a prāyaścitta afterwards. If it is done after the pūrṇāhuti there is no prāyaścitta.
11. The pūrṇāhuti exists for the sake of prāyaścitta. Vasordhārā should not be performed there.
12. According to the statement of the Baudhāyana Paribhāṣā Sūtra:
ato'nye karmavyañjakā upahomāḥ pṛthagviniviṣṭā anyonyam upajīvantaḥ. tadānīm eva teṣv ācāryā ūhasannamanaiśca mantrair yajñaṃ pratisandadhur avicchedāya.
(Other than these are the upahomas that characterise the rite (karma-vyañjaka), set apart separately, depending on one another; at that very time the ācāryas joined the sacrifice together with mantras adapted by ūha and sannamana (modification), so that there be no break.)
— vasordhārā becomes a karma-vyañjaka for the Rudra homa. Therefore it must be included within the upahoma itself.
**Reflection on these points**
In the rule for the upahoma of the agnimukha taught in the gṛhya, there is the procedure of offering with the sruva, the darvī and the sruc. (There is also a procedure of offering with the hand; that matter is separate.)
1. In the Gṛhya Sūtra, the measure of the sruc is stated as 21 aṅgulas (finger-breadths). The measures of its bowl (bila) and its height (ucchrāya) are also stated. What is used in vasordhārā is the mahāsruc. It is many times larger than this sruc. No injunction is seen in the Gṛhya Sūtra for offering in the upahoma with this mahāsruc, exceeding the measure of the upahoma sruc.
2. There is an injunction that the ghee oblation should be offered into the fire from a height of four aṅgulas. Here, with the mahāsruc, the oblation falls into the fire from a height of about 32 aṅgulas. This is not the rule of the upahoma.
3. A ghee oblation made as a continuous stream (santatadhārā) has none of the characteristics of an upahoma.
4. Vasordhārā must be performed standing. Is there anywhere a procedure of performing an upahoma while standing? According to the Baudhāyana Sūtra statement pākayajñasaṃsthānāṃ na tiṣṭhaddhomo vidyate vijñāyate ca ("For the pākayajña forms there is no offering while standing; and this is known [from the Śruti]"), there is an injunction that the homas of the seven pākayajña-saṃsthās must not be performed standing. There is no injunction for performing vasordhārā seated. Clear opposition to performing vasordhārā standing (uttiṣṭhan) is found in the Gṛhya Sūtra itself.
5. The ghee must be taken from the ājyasthālī (ghee vessel). In vasordhārā, the ghee is to be poured into the mahāsruc from the ghee-pot (ghṛtakumbha). Here too no characteristic of the upahoma is seen.
6. Setting up two posts, placing the mahāsruc on them and offering is not included among the rules of the upahoma.
7. Since Sāyaṇa's commentary says anuvākabhedas tv ayajñasaṃyukte karmaṇi pṛthaṅmantratvenānuṣṭheyatvād upapadyate ("The division by anuvākas is appropriate in a rite not connected with the sacrifice, because there they are to be performed as separate mantras"), offering in the upahoma with [the whole Camaka as] a single mantra goes against the rule of the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa. If it is said that it is not a contradiction and is acceptable, no injunctive statement (vidhāyaka vākya) is seen to the effect that it may be used both ways, as separate mantras and as a single mantra.
8. According to no sūtra of the gṛhya is there seen any scope for bringing the vasordhārā homa, which is an independent rite (svatantra-karma), into the upahoma. There are no injunctive statements for including it as a special injunction (viśeṣa-vidhi).
9. In the smārta Rudra homa there are rules such as one anuvāka of the Camaka for one rūpaka, the number of repetitions (āvartana), and so on.
There are the statements of Baudhāyana, the statements of the ṛṣis Śātātapa, Kauśika and Vyāsa, and statements of the Merutantra. Nowhere among these has the complete Camaka been added for the sake of vasordhārā. Had it been absolutely necessary, they would have added it. The nibandha authors too have followed this very thing in stating the prayoga procedure. If in the smārta Rudra homa the Rudra homa and the vasordhārā were of equal importance (sama-pradhāna), such an equally principal vasordhārā is not found even in the ṛṣi statements. The ṛṣis themselves have not enjoined it, nor have the nibandha authors; yet if it is added on the ground that it is "unstated" (anukta), does it become an injunction? It may rather be called a non-injunction (avidhi). Even if it were to become an injunction, no injunctive statement is seen for doing it in the upahoma after the Camaka oblations.
10. In the Svāhākāra-vidhi several methods are given for offering the Camaka according to the rules of the upahoma. There is no injunction for offering it in the upahoma as a single mantra. The rule is only that svāhā is added at the end of the mantra and the offering is made at the final "ā" of that svāhā. If the vasordhārā is performed in the manner dvādaśa dvādaśāni juhoti, or vājaśca me svāhā, prasavaśca me svāhā, the rule of offering at the final "ā" of the svāhā will be violated.
11. "Since the paridhis and paristaraṇa are not present, vasordhārā cannot be performed after the pūrṇāhuti for the pleasure of the principal deity; after the samiṣṭayajus homa (from yajña yajñaṃ gaccha.... up to vāte dhāḥ svāhā) no homa is stated in the sūtra. Therefore it cannot be done after the pūrṇāhuti. Since the Āpastamba Sūtra says that the upahoma extends up to just before the samiṣṭayajus homa, it might occasionally be done before the pūrṇāhuti. Yet, since the paridhis and paristaraṇa are not present, that is not appropriate. It must come within the upahoma itself" — this is the strong argument of the party who perform vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt. Let us look into it. In the text Agnimukha Prakāśa it is said as follows: having stated that in the agnimukha section of the Baudhāyana Gṛhya the pūrṇāhuti is not laid down in a sūtra, it then says that in the aupāsana a pūrṇāhuti of four ladlefuls (caturgṛhīta) with the mantra sapta te agne is stated in the sūtra; that in the Gṛhya Saṃgraha there is a procedure of pūrṇāhuti with a stream from the sruva; that in the Prayoga Tilaka the pūrṇāhuti is with the mantra devā gātuvido; that in the śrauta procedure the pūrṇāhuti is with the samiṣṭayajus mantras from yajña yajñaṃ gaccha up to vāte dhāḥ svāhā, and that this itself stands in the place of the gṛhya pūrṇāhuti; and that in the navagraha śānti the pūrṇāhuti with the mantra mūrdhānaṃ is in the sūtra. Having discussed this at length, it is stated that in kāmya and śānti homas the pūrṇāhuti with the mantra mūrdhānaṃ is appropriate. What becomes clear from this is that in smārta homas no specific mantra for the pūrṇāhuti is stated in the sūtra. If the mūrdhānaṃ mantra stated for the navagraha śānti is applied, that single mantra is enough. But in the nibandha texts/prayoga texts, several mantras besides this, such as sapta te agne and devā gātuvido, are found enjoined in the pūrṇāhuti. It is also in the conduct of the learned (śiṣṭācāra). These have been added from various sources. In that case no compulsory rule is seen that no oblation should be offered after the samiṣṭayajus homa. Even if this mantra is omitted, there is no defect. In the Saṃskāra Ratnamālā, in the navagraha śānti, several mantras are stated for the pūrṇāhuti, and the samiṣṭayajus mantra is not mentioned at all.
12. In the text Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda Svāhākāra-vidhi, edited jointly by seven scholars — Rāmacandra Śrauti of Gokarṇa, Kumāra Purāṇika of Gokarṇa, Rāmeśvara Avadhāni of Bengaluru, Śaṅkaranārāyaṇa Ghanapāṭhī of Sampekaṭṭe, So. Ti. Nāgarāja, Amai Anantakṛṣṇa Ghanapāṭhī and Muḍipu Subrahmaṇya Bhaṭṭa — it is stated in the pūrṇāhuti of the saṃhitā homa: devā gātuvidaḥ, sapta te agne, mūrdhānam ityādi pūrṇāhutiṃ vasordhārāṃ ca hutvā.... ("having offered the pūrṇāhuti with devā gātuvidaḥ, sapta te agne, mūrdhānam and the rest, and the vasordhārā..."). The first oblation is with the third of the samiṣṭayajus mantras itself; it is not the final oblation. After it come two mantras, and by the word ityādi ("and the rest") there is scope to include other suitable mantras. After that comes the vasordhārā. From this it is understood that in the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa there is no compulsory rule that the final oblation in the pūrṇāhuti must be with the samiṣṭayajus mantras. It also becomes clear that the place of the vasordhārā is after the pūrṇāhuti. Therefore there is no obstacle whatever to performing the pūrṇāhuti with other mantras even after the samiṣṭayajus homa. In the pūrṇāhuti performed for the pleasure of Agni, according to the procedure stated in the sūtra itself, the paridhis and paristaraṇa are not present. (In another procedure the 64 darbhas of the paristaraṇa are present; the paridhis are not.)
13. In the Veda there is the Śatarudrīya homa; the Camaka anuvākas are not there. In the Veda, Śatarudrīya means only the Rudra praśna. There, there is only the option of three or six oblations. The homa is with a single repetition only. Likewise, the Camaka anuvākas bear the designation vasordhārā. Here there are options such as two mantras / one mantra / 144 oblations / 342 oblations and so on. In the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa, on the other hand, the Rudra homa has designations such as Rudra, Rudrī and so on. There are different offering-materials (dravyas). Principally there are six kinds of oblation options. It goes up to 14,641 repetitions. Designations such as Rudra include the Camakas as well; the Camaka must necessarily be included. For the Camakas too it must be according to the rule (one anuvāka of the Camaka for one Rudra) — one Camaka for eleven Rudras. Here the material stated for the Rudra Namaka applies to the Camakas as well; there is no separate material for the Camakas. Here, in the smārta Rudra homa, it must be understood that by the oblations of the Rudra Namaka the pacification of Śiva's fierce form (ghora-tanu-śamana) is accomplished, and by the Camaka oblations the pleasing of Śiva's auspicious form (śiva-tanu-prīṇana). Those meanings are in the Namaka and Camaka mantras themselves. If the pleasing of the auspicious form does not take place through the Camakas, then neither does the pacification of the fierce form take place through the Namaka oblations, since the one is related to the other. If the continuous-stream vasordhārā is added to the upahoma for the pleasing of Śiva's auspicious form, then the Śatarudrīya homa with a stream of milk through an arka leaf must also necessarily be added for the pacification of Śiva's fierce form. If it is not added, the rite becomes half a rite, or an incomplete rite. Bringing in the vasordhārā alone would be like bringing only one head of the two-headed Gaṇḍabheruṇḍa bird. In the rule of the Śatarudrīya homa and the vasordhārā stated in the Veda, for one complete repetition of the Namakas there is only one complete set of the Camaka anuvākas. There is no additional repetition. In the smārta Rudra homa the rule is one anuvāka of the Camaka for one complete Namaka. In accordance with the rule, the procedure of the homa also changes.
14. So. Ti. Nāgarāja has written as follows in the Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda Svāhākāra-vidhi:
camakādhyāyasthamantrāṇām agnicayane vasordhārākarmaṇi viniyogaḥ. tatra "agnāviṣṇū.... vājebhir āgatam" iti prathamamantrasya caturgṛhītahome viniyogaḥ. tataḥ "vājaśca me.... adhipatiśca" ityantenaikena mantreṇa vasordhārāhomo'nuṣṭhīyate. ekādaśānuvākātmaka eko mantraḥ.
(The mantras of the Camakādhyāya, in the agnicayana: the first mantra agnāviṣṇū... is employed as a caturgṛhīta homa, and the eleven anuvākas from vājaśca me up to adhipatiśca are employed as a single mantra in the vasordhārā rite.)
...... "vājaśca me" ityādāv ekādaśānuvākabhedas tv ayajñasaṃyukte kalpa iti sāyaṇācāryāḥ.
(Sāyaṇācārya has said that the option of eleven oblations, by dividing vājaśca me and the rest into eleven anuvākas, belongs to the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa.) From this it is clear that in the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa, after 11/12 oblations have been offered with the Camaka divided by anuvākas, the Camakas in their single-mantra form belonging to the yajñasaṃyukta-kalpa cannot again be added as a vasordhārā rite; it would also contradict Sāyaṇa's commentary.
15. If the pleasing of Śiva's auspicious form were accomplished only by a vasordhārā of a single repetition, then performing a Śatarudrīya homa of a single repetition would suffice, and the pacification of the fierce form would be accomplished. Then there would have been no need at all for a Rudra homa of many repetitions; there would have been an injunction of a single-repetition Śatarudrīya homa followed by vasordhārā.
16. Since in the smārta [procedure] there is a rule fixing how many oblations there are for the Namakas and how many for the Camakas, if vasordhārā is included in the upahoma, there will be an excess number of oblations — one oblation / two oblations / 144 oblations / 342 oblations / 401 oblations and so on — because it is done with the Camakas themselves. If it is done after the pūrṇāhuti, as a means of attaining a desired fruit, this problem does not arise.
17. In the Karmavipāka Mahārṇava:
tatra 'agnā viṣṇū sa joṣaseti caturgṛhītaṃ hutvety upakramya 'vājaśca me prasavaśca ma' iti santatāṃ vasordhārāṃ juhoty āmantrasamāpanād iti. baudhāyanena prathamām ṛcam apāsyāvaśiṣṭasya camakasyaika mantratvaṃ vasordhārāyām abhihitam. tenaiva nyāyena yadaikavāraṃ namakānuvākāvṛtyā''jyena pratimantraṃ yatra homaḥ kriyate tadā tatra camake prathamām ṛcaṃ paṭhitvā caturgṛhītena hutvā'vaśiṣṭena camakena santatāṃ dhārāṃ juhuyāt.
(Here it is stated, as taught by Baudhāyana, as a maxim: if one repetition of the Namaka anuvākas is offered as a homa with ghee, then the first mantra of the Camaka is offered with a caturgṛhīta of ghee, and afterwards a continuous vasordhārā is performed from vājaśca me up to the end.)
yadā tu tilādibhir homo namakena tadābhirudraṃ tilādibhir adravadravyaiḥ santatadhārayā aniṣpatteḥ ayajñasaṃyukte karmaṇi japādau tv anuvāka bhedasya pṛthaṅmantratvenānuṣṭhānāt.
(Since a continuous stream cannot be achieved with non-liquid materials such as sesame, it is said that in the ayajñasaṃyukta-kalpa [the Camaka] should be employed as 12 mantras; hence the material stated for the Namaka applies to the Camaka as well.) Then, if vasordhārā is to be performed, the rule would follow that it must be done with that same material. That cannot be achieved. Further on, having stated the employment of the Camaka in the 11-mantra procedure and the 12-mantra procedure, it says:
ayaṃ ca nyāyo dravādravadravyasādhāraṇaḥ, sarvatra vasordhārā tv ājyena. vasordhārāyā abhilaṣitaphalaprāpti hetutvāt
(This maxim is common to both liquid and non-liquid materials — that is, it is a single rule. For the Namakas and the Camakas there is one and the same material. The vasordhārā alone must be done with ghee; the vasudhārā is to be performed for the attainment of a desired fruit.) In that case it is not an aṅga of the Rudra homa. It can be clearly understood that the author of the Mahārṇava meant precisely that the vasudhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti, for the attainment of additional fruit.
18. In the texts Śānti Kusumākara and the Mahānyāsa as taught in the Mahārṇava, vasordhārā is given before the sviṣṭakṛt. These are prayoga texts, and they have not given any root injunctive statement for performing vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt itself. There is a saṅkalpa stating that it is for the pleasing of Śiva's auspicious form. For the pacification of the fierce form there is no Śatarudrīya homa with a continuous stream of milk; the homa that is there is that of the smārta Rudra homa. It may be said that after the word ante stated in the Mahārṇava came to be interpreted as "after the Camaka oblations" and this became customary in certain regions, these authors, being from those very regions, simply turned what had become customary into the prayoga procedure. They have not given any ṛṣi statement, sūtra statement or Mīmāṃsā maxim as authority.
19. Some scholars object that what the nibandha authors enjoin does not become an injunction; [they say that] since vasordhārā is not stated in the smārta Rudra homa according to the original ṛṣi statements, smṛtis and purāṇas, vasordhārā is not necessary. In the original sources there is only the daśāṃśa (one-tenth) homa and the complete homa; there is no śatāṃśa (one-hundredth) homa. In the daśāṃśa, one should not perform a daśāṃśa for the remaining rūpaka. This procedure is stated in one place in the Karmavipāka Mahārṇava, and is also in the Śāntisāra. Yet throughout the whole of India, the daśāṃśa and śatāṃśa homas, the daśāṃśa for the remaining rūpaka and so on are all being practised solely on the basis of injunctions laid down by the nibandha authors. The smārta Rudra homa is being performed throughout the country solely by the injunctions laid down according to Mīmāṃsā maxims by Viśveśvara Bhaṭṭa, author of the celebrated Madana Mahārṇava, and by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa of Kāśī, the great Mīmāṃsaka who authored works such as the Rudrānuṣṭhāna Paddhati, the Prayoga Ratna and the Tristhalī Setu. It was the author of the Madana Mahārṇava who first enjoined it. He did not clarify whether the expression ante vasordhārā means after the Camaka homa or at the end of the homa. Several indications are seen for deciding that it means the end of the homa. Later nibandha authors and writers — in the Rudrānuṣṭhāna Paddhati, the Śānti Kamalākara, the Vidhāna Pārijāta, the Śāntisāra, and the Ṛgvedīya and Hiraṇyakeśīya Brahmakarma Samuccayas — have made clear that it is after the pūrṇāhuti. Not one of them stated the vasudhārā within the upahoma as an aṅga of the Rudra homa. Kamalākara Bhaṭṭa, author of the Nirṇayasindhu, has decided and stated most clearly that the vasordhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti. All of these have followed Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa's Rudrānuṣṭhāna Paddhati for the procedure of the Rudra homa; they have not followed the Madana Mahārṇava to any great extent.
20. The Rudra Ekādaśinī homa, which is very widely performed in Tamil Nadu and Kerala, belongs to the daśāṃśa homa option and is performed precisely according to the procedure enjoined by the nibandha texts Karmavipāka Mahārṇava or Māndhātṛ Mahārṇava. The saṅkalpa itself is "according to the method stated in the Mahārṇava, for the sake of prāyaścitta". The very scholars who argue that what the nibandha authors enjoin does not become an injunction follow the Rudra Ekādaśinī homa practised in Tamil Nadu and Kerala, with a daśāṃśa of oblations for the remaining rūpaka, as enjoined by the nibandha authors! Although there is no explicit statement in the Mahārṇava of where ante vasordhārā is placed, even though later nibandha authors and writers have made clear that the vasordhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti, that does not become an injunction! Yet what they themselves enjoin, bringing vasordhārā from the śrauta and following the agnimukha maxim agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāntareṇopahomāḥ, becomes an injunction!
21. The claim that the vasordhārā should be done in the upahoma because there is a prāyaścitta afterwards is not sound. Until the very end of the homa there remains every possibility of lapses in material (dravya-lopa), in mantra (mantra-lopa) and in action (kriyā-lopa). If a mistake is made in reciting the very mantra of the prāyaścitta oblation, or if a lapse in material or action occurs, what then is the prāyaścitta? It has to be understood that the remembrance of Viṣṇu and the japa of the three names (nāmatraya-japa) done at the offering-up of the rite (karma-samarpaṇa) is the final prāyaścitta.
22. In the Śānti Kamalākara, a statement of Śaunaka reads as follows:
ayāś cetyādibhir hutvā samudrād ūrmisūktataḥ | santatām ājyadhārāṃ tāṃ pūrṇāhutim athācaret ||
(Having offered with ayāś ca and the other [mantras], one should then perform, with the sūkta samudrād ūrmiḥ, that continuous stream of ghee as the pūrṇāhuti.) Since here a continuous stream of ghee is stated within the pūrṇāhuti, and since the vasordhārā also consists of a continuous stream of ghee, this supports performing the vasordhārā together with the pūrṇāhuti.
The injunctive statements and ṛṣi-statement authorities that form the basis of the smārta Rudra homa are found as follows.
1. In the Baudhāyana Gṛhyaśeṣa Sūtra: namas te rudra manyava ity ekādaśānuvākān japet....... evam ekādaśakṛtvo'bhiṣiñcati. japānte japānte agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā ity ekādaśānuvākānām ekam ekam anuvākaṃ japet ("One should recite the eleven anuvākas beginning namas te rudra manyave ....... thus he performs the abhiṣeka eleven times. At the end of each japa, one should recite one by one an anuvāka of the eleven anuvākas beginning agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā"). This very rule enjoined here — one anuvāka of the Camaka for one complete Namaka — has been followed by all nibandha authors and writers in the smārta Rudra anuṣṭhāna. Here, at the beginning, it says only arcanābhiṣekavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ("we shall explain the procedure of worship and abhiṣeka"); there is no mention of homa. But since the Mahānyāsa begins with japahomārcanābhiṣekavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ("we shall explain the procedure of japa, homa, worship and abhiṣeka"), and since further on there is tato yajanam ārabhet ("then one should begin the sacrifice"), the homa procedure too must be understood as implied (upalakṣaṇa). Following precisely the rule of one anuvāka of the Camaka for one Namaka, the number of oblations, up to the Atirudra homa, is stated in many texts. Since vasordhārā has not been included anywhere in these, vasordhārā is not an aṅga of the Rudra homa. Just as in the śrauta Śatarudrīya homa there is a stream of milk on the final brick, so in the smārta Rudrābhiṣeka too there is abhiṣeka of the Śiva-liṅga with milk and other substances. There is abhiṣeka with the Camaka as well. Had the vasordhārā been a compulsory rite, then after the abhiṣeka with the Camakas was completed, another abhiṣeka with the vasordhārā anuvākas would have had to be prescribed. There is no such sūtra statement. Since one and the same rule for the number and sequence of the Namaka and Camaka is seen in all three — japa, homa and abhiṣeka — it is established that, according to the Baudhāyana Sūtra, vasordhārā is not an aṅga of the Rudra homa.
3. In the Smṛtisārasamuccaya, the statement of the sage Vyāsa:
ekaikāvṛttipūrveṇa camakena samaṃ budhaḥ | karoti homaṃ niyataṃ tilair ājyāplutais tatheti ||
(The wise one, preceding it with a single recitation each time, together with the camaka, regularly performs the homa with sesame steeped in ghee.)
Thus homa with ghee-smeared sesame is prescribed here, and vasordhārā is not mentioned.
4. In the Saṃskāragaṇapati there is a statement from the Kālikā Purāṇa which, after prescribing the Rudra japa, says:
ghṛtāktair bilvapatraiś ca rudrair homaṃ prakalpayet ||
(With bilva leaves smeared with ghee, one should perform the homa with the Rudra [mantras].)
Thus homa with ghee-smeared bilva leaves is prescribed, and vasordhārā is not stated.
5. In Bhaṭṭabhāskara's commentary on the Rudrādhyāya, the original verses of the Merutantra are quoted:
ekaḥ pāṭho namas te 'sya hy anuvākaḥ parasya ca | evaṃ bhavāya namas te 'syāgnāviṣṇū tathaikakam | iyaṃ rudrī samākhyātā raudrapāpanikṛntanī ...... anena vihito homaḥ somayāgaphalapradaḥ ||
(One recitation of "namas te" and one anuvāka of the following [camaka]; in the same way, "bhavāya namas te" with "agnāviṣṇū", one each. This is called the Rudrī, which cuts away terrible sins ...... A homa performed with this bestows the fruit of a Soma sacrifice.)
Here only the homa of the namaka and camaka is stated; vasordhārā is not mentioned after the camaka oblations.
6. Bhaṭṭabhāskara's commentary refers to the procedure taught by Śaunaka:
rudramahārudrātirudreṣv anyatamaṃ japtvoktasaṃkhyayā pāyasaṃ juhuyāt ||
(Having performed the japa of any one of the Rudra, Mahārudra or Atirudra, one should offer pāyasa in the stated number.)
Here too there is no mention of vasordhārā.
7. In Bhaṭṭabhāskara's commentary itself, there is the following statement given as the procedure taught by Baudhāyana:
rudramahārudrātirudrāṇām anyatamaṃ japtvoktasaṃkhyayā rāṣṭrakāmo yavānām ājyāktānām ayutaṃ juhuyāt. atha śrīkāmasya. rudramahārudrātirudrāṇām anyatamaṃ japtvā pāyasenāyutaṃ juhuyāt. śriyaṃ labhate.
(One who desires a kingdom, having performed the japa of any one of the Rudra, Mahārudra or Atirudra in the stated number, should offer ten thousand [oblations] of barley smeared with ghee. Now for one who desires prosperity: having performed the japa of any one of the Rudra, Mahārudra or Atirudra, he should offer ten thousand [oblations] of pāyasa. He obtains prosperity.)
Here too vasordhārā with the camaka anuvākas is not prescribed.
8. In Bhaṭṭabhāskara's commentary itself, the statement of the sage Sanatkumāra in the Kālikā Purāṇa:
ekādaśa dināny evam arcayet taṃ maheśvaram ..... dināny ekādaśair vādau pūjānte homam ācaret | sājyabilvadalair nityaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āsthitaḥ ......
(In this way one should worship Maheśvara for eleven days ..... for the eleven days, or at the beginning, one should perform homa at the end of the pūjā, daily, with bilva leaves together with ghee, facing the south ......)
Here too vasordhārā is not enjoined.
9. In the Śātātapa Smṛti:
mahārudrajapaṃ caiva kārayec ca yathāvidhi |
ṣaḍaṅgaikādaśai rudrai rudraḥ samabhidhīyate | rudrais tu caikādaśabhir mahārudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ekādaśabhir etais tu atirudraś ca kathyate | juhuyāc ca daśāṃśena dūrvayāyutasaṃkhyayā |
(And one should have the Mahārudra japa performed according to rule. [The recitation] with the six aṅgas and eleven Rudras is called a Rudra; eleven Rudras are called a Mahārudra; and eleven of these are called an Atirudra. And one should offer homa with dūrvā grass, one tenth [of the japa], numbering ten thousand.)
So it is stated. Here too the one-tenth homa is prescribed, and vasordhārā is not mentioned after the one-tenth homa.
10. The Īśāna Saṃhitā deals with the smārta Rudra homa at length. A homa of one tenth of the japa with ghee-smeared sesame is prescribed, and after the one-tenth homa there are oblations to different deities with different substances using 34 mantras, but nowhere is an oblation by vasordhārā prescribed. Even at the pūrṇāhuti, vasordhārā is not prescribed. (The Rudra homa procedure of the Īśāna Saṃhitā is given as part of the current Rudra homa procedure in the Ṛddhikarmadīpāvali, and separately as a procedure in the work Śiva Mantropāsana Dīpikā.)
Thus, for the smārta Rudra homa we find statements of the sages Baudhāyana, Śaunaka, Śātātapa, Vyāsa and Sanatkumāra, and statements of the Kālikā Purāṇa, the Merutantra and the Īśāna Saṃhitā; since vasordhārā is not stated as a component (aṅga) of the Rudra homa in any of them, it is established that vasordhārā is not an aṅga of the Rudra homa. Everywhere there is only the homa of the namaka and camaka, and after it no vasordhārā in a continuous stream with the camakas is stated. (If vasordhārā were an aṅga of the Rudra homa, then all the way up to the Atirudra homa they would have stated only the namaka homa and then stated vasordhārā afterwards. That too is not the case.) If it is included among the upahomas as an aṅga of the Rudra homa, it contradicts the statements of the sages.
apratiṣiddham anuktam anyato grāhyam
(What is not stated [here] and is not prohibited may be adopted from elsewhere.)
According to this statement found in the Agnimukha Prakāśa, a vasordhārā performed again with the camakas after the complete homa, the one-tenth homa or the one-hundredth homa (as per the rule of numbers) becomes prohibited; it is not "unprohibited". Since there is also the statement "anuktam anyato grāhyaṃ aviruddham apekṣitam" (what is not stated may be adopted from elsewhere if it is not contradictory and is required), something unstated may be adopted when it is required only if it is not contradictory. Here, since it is contradictory, it cannot be adopted. It is clear that vasordhārā was not part of the smārta Rudra homa, and that it began only after the author of the Mahārṇava prescribed it.
**An examination of why the ancient texts prescribed vasordhārā only after the pūrṇāhuti**
1. In the Baudhāyana Śrautasūtra, the tenth praśna contains the section on agnicayana. After the procedures of agnicayana spread over several days (usually ten days), there is the Śatarudrīya homa.
On the final brick (carameṣṭakā) of the fifth layer: a bamboo is made into a channel, an arka leaf is attached to its tip, and through the arka leaf goat's milk is poured in a continuous stream onto the final brick, as an abhiṣeka, with the Rudra anuvākas divided into 16 mantra sections. Whichever mantra division is used, 3, 6 or 16, the stream of milk must be continuous. This itself is the homa (although the term "homa" is not used in the śrauta, it is used here as a term of common usage). There is no actual fire here; the brick itself is the form of Agni. After that there is the singing of Sāman chants, and homa with certain mantras.
After that comes the dragging of the frog (maṇḍūkavikarṣaṇa).
Then, after some further rites, the carrying forward of the fire (agnipraṇayana) takes place. After that come the Vaiśvānareṣṭi and other procedures.
After this, vasordhārā is performed with ghee into the actual fire, with the camaka anuvākas.
(Vasordhārā is not performed immediately after the Rudra homa. In the Veda, vasordhārā is not stated as immediately following the Rudra homa.)
The tenth praśna of the Baudhāyana Śrautasūtra contains the procedure of agnicayana. The tenth praśna has 19 principal sections (kaṇḍikā) and within them 59 sub-sections. Of these, the Śatarudrīya homa is in the 48th sub-section of the 16th principal section. Further on, in the 50th sub-section of the 17th principal section, it first directs the setting out (āsādana) of the udumbara-wood sruva, the udumbara-wood droṇa and the udumbara-wood praseka (the great ladle, mahāsruc, of the vasordhārā). Next comes the pūrṇāhuti filled with curds before the agnipraṇayana (with the puronuvākyā and yājyā mantras "naktoṣāsā" and "agne sahasrākṣa"). This itself is the pūrṇāhuti of the Śatarudrīya. Then comes the installation of the fire (agnipratiṣṭhā). In the 52nd sub-section of the same principal section, further on, there is a caturgṛhīta pūrṇāhuti with the mantra "sapta te agne". Further on, after the Vaiśvānara and Māruta homas, comes the vasordhārā. Vasordhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti and, even after that, only after the oblations relating to the deity Agni. It thus follows that vasordhārā is enjoined after a caturgṛhīta pūrṇāhuti. This kind of vasordhārā, after the pūrṇāhuti and some oblations, is found also in the Āpastamba Śrautasūtra, the Satyāṣāḍha Śrautasūtra, the Kātyāyana Śrautasūtra and the Vādhūla Śrautasūtra. The vasordhārā is in the 54th sub-section. Although the sub-sections here are different, they are rites belonging to one and the same principal section. At the beginning there is the setting out of the udumbara great ladle, and the vasordhārā is performed with that very great ladle (praseka). After the vasordhārā and some subsequent acts, the 17th principal section concludes within the very sub-section that contains the vasordhārā. Since this is so, it is established that the whole section is interconnected. Then the view that vasordhārā comes after the pūrṇāhuti cannot be denied. The place of vasordhārā is after the pūrṇāhuti; it is only that it is not immediately after it. This appears to be one reason why the ancient texts prescribed vasordhārā after the pūrṇāhuti.
2. Sāyaṇa's commentary on the Rudrādhyāya says this:
vasor dhanasya dhārā sāntatyaṃ yayāhutyā labhyate seyam āhutir vasordhārā tāṃ juhuyāt.
(Vasu means wealth; the oblation by which a stream, a continuity of it, is obtained, that oblation is the vasordhārā; one should offer with it.)
The authors of the digests (nibandhas) have stated vasordhārā only for the desire of greater fruit:
phalabhūyastvakāmo vasordhāreṇa juhuyāt
(One who desires an abundance of fruit should offer with the vasordhārā.)
It is not a mandatory rule. The source of this is seen in Sāyaṇa's commentary.
3. In the Matsya Purāṇa, vasordhārā is stated in the navagraha śānti of one lakh oblations. The authors of the Mahārṇava have also cited the work Cintāmaṇi. The Āgneya sūkta, the "ā te pitar marutām" sūkta, the Viṣṇu sūkta, the Aindava sūkta,
the Vaiśvānara sāman and the Jyeṣṭha sāmans are stated. Here too it is stated only after the pūrṇāhuti and only in relation to Agni, not in relation to the navagraha deities, that is, the principal deities. Gradually, the procedural manuals (prayoga texts) prescribed vasordhārā in the navagraha śānti of 1008/108/28 oblations and in other śāntis as well.
4. In the śrauta there is a rule that after the vasordhārā homa the praseka (the great ladle) is to be offered into the fire. It is found in the Baudhāyana Śrautasūtra and in other śrautasūtras too. It is said:
hutvā srukprāsanam. tac cāgnau
(Having offered, the casting away of the ladle; and that into the fire.)
The reason for this is given thus in Karka's commentary on the Kātyāyana Śrautasūtra:
atra tāṃ srucam anuprāsyati yad atrājyaliptaṃ tan ned bahirdhāgner asat.
The ghee smeared on the ladle must not go outside the fire; therefore the ghee-smeared ladle must be offered into the fire. Bhavasvāmin's Kalpavivaraṇa commentary on the Baudhāyana Śrautasūtra says this: "atra asmin kāle samāptāyāṃ prasekam agnāv anupraharati. ghaṭe yad ājyam avaśiṣyate tasmin brahmaudanaṃ pacati." After the vasordhārā homa is completed, the praseka (great ladle) is to be thrown into the fire. With the ghee remaining in the pot, the brahmaudana is to be cooked.
Although in the śrauta agnicayana the ladle is thus offered into the fire, this is not done in the smārta Rudra homa. Even having one great ladle made takes effort. If it were offered into the fire each time, having a great ladle made again and again would indeed be difficult. For practical reasons it is not put into the fire. According to the rule, according to the injunction, it would have to be put in. Can one perform vasordhārā among the upahomas, offer the ladle into the fire, and then perform the sviṣṭakṛt homa? Can one also cook the brahmaudana with the ghee remaining in the pot? There is probably no injunction for that in any gṛhyasūtra. There is no rule in the Agnimukha for offering a sacrificial implement (yajñāyudha) in the middle of the sacrifice. Since it is not offered, one cannot say it should be included among the upahomas either. When there is an injunction to offer the sacrificial implements after the pūrṇāhuti, it can be offered into the fire.
5. The ultimate source of vasordhārā lies in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa of the Śukla Yajurveda. There is a commentary by Sāyaṇa on it, with a detailed explanation of vasordhārā.
Here, the Śatarudrīya homa and the vasordhārā homa are aṅgas of the agnicayana. All the procedures occurring in agnicayana relate principally to the deity Agni. Behind this lies the principle that Rudra himself is the form of Agni. This is not a rite directly addressed to Rudra. In the Śatarudrīya homa it says "atraiṣa sarvo 'gniḥ saṃskṛtaḥ" (here this entire Agni has been consecrated). "vihito 'yaṃ homo rudrarūpatāpannasyāgner upaśamanārtha ity āha" — it says that the Śatarudrīya homa is for the pacification of Agni, who has assumed the form of Rudra. Further on there are many procedures such as the pravargya, the upasad and the maṇḍūkavikarṣaṇa, and all of them are the worship of Agni alone.
atraiṣa sarvo 'gniḥ saṃskṛtaḥ. sa eṣo 'tra vasuḥ. tasmai devā etāṃ dhārāṃ prāgṛhṇan. tayainam aprīṇan. tad yad etasmai vasava etāṃ dhārāṃ pragṛhṇan tasmād enāṃ vasordhārety ācakṣate. tathaivāsmā ayam etāṃ dhārāṃ pragṛhṇāti. tayainaṃ prīṇāti.
Agni has been consecrated. Agni himself is here the form of vasu. By the stream of this vasudhārā the deities are satisfied. Therefore it is called vasordhārā. Vasu means wealth, and it also means Agni. Hence, since the pūrṇāhuti performed in the smārta rite is also done for the fullness of the sacrifice and is an oblation offered to the deity Agni himself, it is proper to perform vasordhārā in the smārta Rudra homa after the pūrṇāhuti, for the pleasure of Agni. Since the pūrṇāhuti too is said to satisfy all the deities, and since vasordhārā too is satisfying to the deities, it is appropriate to perform it right here.
atha punas tām eva
vasordhārāṃ saṃskṛtāgner abhiṣekātmanā praśaṃsati
Here too vasordhārā is said to be an abhiṣeka performed for the consecrated Agni.
6. vājaś ca me prasavaś ca me ityādi mantroktā vājādayaḥ kāmyamānatvāt kāmaśabdenocyate. taiś ca etayā vasordhārayā ca abhiṣiñcet.
(The vāja and the rest stated in the mantras "vājaś ca me prasavaś ca me" and so on are called by the word kāma because they are things desired. With them and with this vasordhārā one should consecrate.)
Here the quality of being desired is attributed to "vājaś ca me prasavaś ca me" and the rest. Since the camaka mantras too have these fruits, in the smārta Rudra homa it is proper to consecrate Agni with vasordhārā at the end of the homa, that is, after the pūrṇāhuti, for the desire of greater fruit. Nor is there a mandatory rule that it must be performed.
7. In the Veda, the pacification of Śiva's terrible form (ghoratanu) by the Śatarudrīya homa, and the gratification of Śiva's form (śivatanu) by the vasordhārā, are stated. This is the yajñasaṃyukta kalpa (the procedure connected with the śrauta sacrifice). Bhaṭṭabhāskara's commentary gives the procedure for the Rudra rite according to this kalpa. If this is accepted as the original model (mūlaprakṛti) and followed in the smārta Rudra homa, then one would have to do it thus: following one of the options of 3/6/16 divisions, a stream of milk through an arka leaf, in a single recitation, as a homa performed standing (tiṣṭhaddhoma, with rules such as navel-deep, knee-deep and so on); completing the Śatarudrīya homa in this way, and then the vasordhārā homa with the camaka anuvākas, with a stream of ghee from the great ladle, also performed standing. One complete camaka for one complete namaka. There are no injunctive statements for this to be carried over by extension (atideśa) into the ayajñasaṃyukta kalpa (the procedure not connected with the śrauta sacrifice). It cannot be applied to a Rudra homa of 11/121/1331/14641 recitations, or to a one-hundredth or one-tenth homa. If the smārta homas up to the Mahārudra are regarded as transformed versions of the śrauta Śatarudrīya, then the camaka homa too becomes a transformed version of the Vedic vasordhārā. The Śatarudrīya, in transformed form, has come into the smārta as the Rudra homa, and the camaka is also present there. But the argument that vasordhārā must come over as it is, without transformation, is a strange one. It is merely a device used to justify what has been done by custom.
The following is a summary of what Vidvān Gaṇapati Bhaṭṭa of Kibbaḷḷi has said about vasordhārā in the smārta Rudra homa, and of the articles written by Vidvān Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa of Yallāpura, Vidvān Bālacandra Bhaṭṭa of Bhaṭrakeri and Vidvān Parameśvara Bhaṭṭa of Puṭṭanamane. All of them have expressed the view that performing vasordhārā after the pūrṇāhuti is what accords with the śāstra. (Some śrauta scholars have provided much information about agnicayana in the Baudhāyana Śrautasūtra and the Āpastamba Śrautasūtra, and have stated that if vasordhārā is to be performed in the smārta Rudra homa, it is appropriate to perform it only after the pūrṇāhuti. For certain reasons, they have asked that their names not be mentioned in the article.)
1. In the śrauta, in the cayana, the oblations with the Rudra namaka anuvākas are made only with a division into three mantra sections, six mantra sections or 16 mantra sections. The division into 48/169 mantras does not exist in the śrauta. Nor do the Mahārudra and Atirudra; they are stated only in the smārta. In the śrauta there is no oblation with the camaka anuvākas right after the Rudra homa; vasordhārā comes after several procedures. Since this rule exists in the śrauta, it is correct to do it this way only in the śrauta. But to apply it in smārta rites an injunctive statement (vidhivākya) is required. For example:
pavitrakaraṇaṃ prokṣaṇīsaṃskāraḥ praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ sruksruvasaṃmārjanam iti darśapūrṇamāsavat tūṣṇīm
(The making of the pavitra, the consecration of the prokṣaṇī water, the bringing forward of the praṇītā water and the cleansing of the sruc and sruva are done silently, as in the Darśapūrṇamāsa.)
Just as here it is indicated that the śrauta procedure is to be followed, an injunctive statement would be needed saying "perform the vasordhārā too as stated in the śrauta". The rules of śrauta sacrifices are one thing and the homa rules of the gṛhya are another. Even within the same rite there are mutual differences in many places. In the present matter of the Rudra homa, since no injunctive statements are found saying "perform the vasordhārā as in the śrauta", if it is done before the sviṣṭakṛt it becomes a vasordhārā without an injunction. If an injunctive statement is found, it may be done. Since in the smārta procedure the Rudra homa rule prescribes vasordhārā together with the pūrṇāhuti, it is correct to do it that way. That alone is a vasordhārā according to rule. There is no mandatory rule that vasordhārā must be performed in the Rudra homa.
agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāntareṇopahomāḥ
(The upahomas [are offered] between Agni and the sviṣṭakṛt.)
This states the definition of the upahoma; it is not a reason for bringing vasordhārā in here. For the status of upahoma to be established, there must be injunctive statements.
2. svāhetyādi santatadhārayeti mīmāṃsakāḥ
("With svāhā and so on, in a continuous stream" — so say the Mīmāṃsakas.)
The matter of vasordhārā can be found in the 11th adhikaraṇa of the 3rd pāda of the 12th adhyāya of the Pūrva Mīmāṃsā.
In the 10th adhikaraṇa, while explaining "mantrāntena karmādisannipātaḥ syāt" (the beginning of the act should coincide with the end of the mantra): a mantra cannot be understood until its last word has been uttered, can it? Therefore it is established that the act is not to be undertaken at the beginning or in the middle of the mantra, but performed at the end of the mantra.
Questioning this, in the 12th adhikaraṇa, pointing out a discrepancy, the prima facie view (pūrvapakṣa) is put forward that in "santatāṃ vasordhārāṃ juhoti" (he offers the vasordhārā continuously) or "dvādaśa dvādaśāni juhoti" (he offers the twelve twelve-fold [oblations]), an unbroken stream or continuity is enjoined, and that at the beginning of the mantra the togetherness of mantra and act is clear. Strangely enough, "santatavacanād dhārāyām ādisaṃyogaḥ" (because of the word "continuous", in the case of a stream the act is joined to the beginning [of the mantra]) is framed as a sūtra stating the pūrvapakṣa.
The established conclusion (siddhānta) is "karmasantāno vā nānākarmatvād itarasyāśakyatvāt" (rather, it is the continuity of the acts, because they are distinct acts and because the other is impossible). Here what is stated is the continuity of all twelve homas, not the continuity of mantra and act! A momentary act cannot proceed along with the mantra! They have argued: "mantrakarmasāntatyasya aśakyatvāt" (because continuity of mantra and act is impossible).
Then is not a conjunction of act and mantra seen in the āghāra homa!? That is the subject of the next adhikaraṇa. "āghāre ca dīrghadhāratvāt" (and in the āghāra, because of the long stream): in the āghāra only the stream-homa is what is to be taken; here too continuity of the act is not what matters! So they have concluded... They have concluded that this word "santatām" does not mean a stream of ghee at the beginning of the mantra, nor a single stream for many mantras! Be that as it may: when it is clear that the vasordhārā in question is offered at the end (pūrṇāhutyante, at the end of the pūrṇāhuti), the exclamation "sviṣṭakṛdantareṇa" (within the sviṣṭakṛt) is a recent one..... In my view, it appears proper to perform the Rudra camaka homa (which is an aṅga of the Rudra homa) within the sviṣṭakṛt, and the continuous-stream homa with the camaka mantras at the end of the pūrṇāhuti.
3. Having relied on these eight texts as authority for the origin of the smārta Rudra homa, to say that the rule these very texts give regarding vasudhārā in the homa so originated is not authoritative — is that not ardhajaratīya (accepting half and rejecting half)? Not merely ardhajaratīya; is there not also the fault of undermining one's own basis (āśrayavyāghāta)?
4. When these very nibandha texts clearly contain a rule regarding vasudhārā, and the question of the relation of principal and subsidiary (aṅgāṅgibhāva) has been settled, what need is there for atideśa?
Those who hold that the sūtra alone is the supreme authority and that whatever lacks a sūtra is baseless must, here too, reason by keeping to the sūtra. In many places the ācāryas such as Baudhāyana themselves state atideśas such as "darśapūrṇamāsavat tūṣṇīm" (silently, as in the Darśapūrṇamāsa). In the context of the smārta Rudra homa, is there a sūtra enjoining such an atideśa? If not, an atideśa that we imagine and perform ourselves would have to be regarded as contrary to the sūtra (utsūtra), or as not in accordance with rule (avaidha), or as baseless.
5. Have the authors of the sūtras stated this atideśa anywhere? Even leaving this problem aside, let us keep the śrauta Rudra homa under consideration here. But statements such as "tasyaite ghoratanū.." and "yatkāma enāṃ juhoti" have fulfilled their purpose by satisfying the expectancy of the bhāvanā of the śrauta Rudra homa. That being so, how can they become authoritative statements for supplying the expectancies of the smārta Rudra homa, such as what is to be achieved and the means? The question arises: what is the authority for extracting (apoddhāra) out of their context the statements of the śrauta Rudra homa, which have fulfilled their purpose in their own context, and using them to supply the expectancies of the smārta Rudra homa, such as what is to be achieved and the means?
6. athāto vasordhārāṃ juhoti. tasyai devā etāṃ dhārāṃ prāgṛhṇan tenainam aprīṇan... tasmād enāṃ vasordhārety ācakṣate... ityādi...
Meaning of the mantra: After the Vaiśvānara and Māruta homas, [comes] the "vasordhārā" homa; of old, the deities offered this stream and through it satisfied Agni. That is why it got the name "vasordhārā". Through it the yajamāna increases the stream of his life and wealth.
yad evaitāṃ vasordhārāṃ juhoti. abhiṣeka evāsyaiṣaḥ. etad vā enaṃ devāḥ sarvaṃ kṛtsnaṃ saṃskṛtya athainam etaiḥ kāmair abhyaṣiñcan...
Meaning of the mantra: This vasordhārā homa is the very occasion of Agni's coronation (paṭṭābhiṣeka). After fully constructing and consecrating the agnicayana altar, they performed an "abhiṣeka" of that Agni through this vasordhārā, for the fulfilment of all desires.
Continuing thus, in the passage "idaṃ ca me idaṃ ca me iti... sā yadaivaiṣā dhārāgniṃ prāpṛṇuyād athaitad yajuḥ pratipadyeta" (when this stream reaches the fire, then he should begin this yajus), its application (viniyoga) with the mantras of the camaka praśna is stated.
7. Neither in the gṛhyasūtra under the sūtra "agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāntareṇa", nor in the Anākulā Vṛtti or the Tātparyadarśana, is it written anywhere in so many words: "perform vasordhārā before the sviṣṭakṛt".
8. The Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa calls vasordhārā "sarvaṃ vai pūrṇam" (all, indeed, is complete).
Is vasordhārā a principal homa or an upahoma? According to Mīmāṃsā, a principal homa must have an independent fruit. Is there a separate injunction anywhere, whether in the gṛhyasūtra or in the śrauta, to call vasordhārā an independent principal rite? No. If it were an upahoma, it should have been finished before the jayādi [homas]; but the universal practice is to perform vasordhārā only after the jayādi.
9. After the principal homas, the sviṣṭakṛt is performed, the jayādi are completed, and then with the mantra "yad asya karmaṇo..." the second sviṣṭakṛt / prāyaścitta oblation with the sruva is given. Only after all these expiations for deficiencies are finished and the paristaraṇas are removed are the pūrṇāhuti and the vasordhārā performed. If vasordhārā is performed before the sviṣṭakṛt, does not using Āpastamba's sūtra "agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāntareṇa" for the vasordhārā homa lead to the fault of breaking the rite (karmabhaṅga)?
10. Stuffing the vasordhārā inside the sviṣṭakṛt does not fit any prayoga. Therefore, performing the vasordhārā at the time of the pūrṇāhuti, after the jayādi and the expiations are finished, is the proper course consistent with all śrauta and smārta procedures.
If vasordhārā is brought under Āpastamba's sūtra "agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāntareṇa" and performed before the first sviṣṭakṛt, where is the place of the jayādi homas that come after it? Which text says that vasordhārā is a minor upahoma in the middle of the sacrifice, or a principal one?
11. Are there sūtras enjoining that vasordhārā must be performed in the vikṛti rites (smārta homas)? [Discussion] of a matter [is meaningful] only when there is first an "injunctive sūtra" (a mandatory rule that it must be done). When the basic rule itself is absent, discussing its position is pointless.
12. To call the camaka mantras of the vasordhārā "upahoma" or "karmavyañjaka" (that which manifests the rite): the camaka mantras have already been applied once in the upahoma. How can the camaka mantras of the vasordhārā be called "karmavyañjaka" a second time? When the principal namaka itself is not present there, the vasordhārā performed at the end is not doing the work of "manifesting" the namaka.
